N. Mandlik, Mānava-Dharma Śāstra with the Commentaries of Medhātithi ..., 2 vols., Bombay: Ganpat Krishnaji's Press, 1886 (M); J. R. Gharpure, Manusmriti with the Bhāshya of Bhaṭṭa Medhātithi, Bombay 1920 (G 1st ed.) and 2nd ed. Poona 1958 (G 2nd ed.); Gaṅgānātha Jha, Manu-Smṛti with the Manubhāṣya of Medhātithi, Calcutta: Asiatic Society of Bengal, 1932–39 (J); and the Dharmakośa (DK). The source page names Jha's edition first; the text is not identical with any single printed edition.

text.body:
atha pañcamo 'dhyāyaḥ
śrutvaitān ṛṣayo dharmān snātakasya yathoditān |
idam ūcur mahātmānam analaprabhavaṃ bhṛgum || 5.1 ||
brahmacārigṛhasthyor adhyāyatrayeṇa ye dharmā vihitās tāñ chrutvā ṛṣayo marīcyādayo bhṛgum ācāryam idaṃ vakṣyamāṇaṃ vastv abruvan pṛṣṭavantaḥ |
nanu cātra snātakasyeti śrūyate | tatra brahmacārigrahaṇaṃ kim artham |
ucyate | vṛttasaṃkīrtanam etat | brahmacāriṇo dharmā uktā eva |
mahātmānam analaprabhavam iti ca bhṛguviśeṣaṇam | analād agneḥ prabhava utpattis yasya tam[1] |
nanu prathame 'dhyāye "ahaṃ prajāḥ sisṛkṣuḥ" (MDh 1.34) ity atra manor apatyaṃ bhṛgur uktaḥ |
satyam | arthavādaḥ | amutra agneḥ sakāśād bhṛgor janma śrutaṃ taddarśanenaivam uktam | tathā ca nāma nirvacanam | "bhṛṣṭād retasaḥ prathamam udadīpyata tad asāv ādityo 'bhavat yad dvitīyam āsīt tad bhṛguḥ" iti | upacārato vaitad ucyate | tejasvitāsāmānyād agner iva prasava iti | na cātrābhiniveṣṭavyaṃ kataraḥ pakṣo yukta iti | anidaṃparatvād asya śāstrasya | sarva evāyaṃ praśnaprativacanasaṃdarbho vakṣyamāṇasyānnadoṣasya gauravajñāpanārthaḥ[2] | parigrahaduṣṭād annasvabhāvaduṣṭaṃ gurutaram iti | saṃbandhidoṣāt svarūpadoṣo balavān antaraṅgatvāt |
nanu ca pūrvaṃ bahutaraṃ prāyaścittaṃ śrūyate "amatyā kṣapaṇaṃ tryaham" (MDh 4.223) iti | idaṃ tu "śeṣeṣūpavased ahaḥ" (MDh 5.20) iti | tat katham asya gurutaratvam |
ucyate | laśunādyapakṣam etat | teṣu hi "matyā jagdhvā patet" (MDh 5.19) iti patitaprāyaścittaṃ bhavati || 5.1||
evaṃ yathoktaṃ viprāṇāṃ svadharmam anutiṣṭhatām |
kathaṃ mṛtyuḥ prabhavati vedaśāstravidāṃ prabho || 5.2 ||
yan maharṣibhiḥ pṛṣṭaṃ tad idānīṃ darśayati | evam iti śāstravyāpāraparāmarśaḥ | yathoktam iti śāstrārthaṃ parāmṛśati | etena śāstrasaṃdarbheṇa yādṛśo dharma uktas tatpunas tam anutiṣṭhatāṃ dvijātīnām | vipragrahaṇasya darśanārthatvād vakṣyati: "etad uktaṃ dvijātīnām" (MDh 5.26) iti | kathaṃ mṛtyuḥ prabhavati, snātakāvasthāyāṃ brahmacaryāvasthāyāṃ vā | yataḥ paripūrṇāyurbhis tair bhavituṃ yuktaṃ puruṣāyuṣajīvibhiḥ | śatavarṣaṃ puruṣāṇām āyus tataḥ purāpamṛtyunā[3] maraṇam eṣāṃ na yuktam | yata uktam "ācārāl labhate hy āyuḥ" (MDh 4.156), "japatāṃ juhvatām" (MDh 4.146) iti || 5.2 ||
na tān uvāca dharmātmā maharṣīn mānavo bhṛguḥ |
śrūyatāṃ yena doṣeṇa mṛtyur viprān jighāṃsati || 5.3 ||
anabhyāsena vedānām ācārasya ca varjanāt |
ālasyād annadoṣāc ca mṛtyur viprān jighāṃsati || 5.4 ||
nanu ca "svadharmam anutiṣṭhatām" iti praśnena yuktam "yena doṣeṇa" iti uttaraś ca grantho naivopapadyate |
ucyate | anabhyāsenetyādidṛṣṭāntatvenocyate | yathā bhavadbhiḥ pratipannā vedānabhyāsādayaḥ purāyuṣo maraṇahetavaḥ, evaṃ vakṣyamāṇo 'nnadoṣaḥ | satsv api vedābhyāsādiṣu na tāvat svadharmo yaḥ pūrvatra kathitaḥ, kiṃ tv ayam annadoṣo garīyastaraḥ | pṛthak prakaraṇāc caitad abhidhīyate[4] || 5.3–4 ||
laśunaṃ gṛñjanaṃ caiva palāṇḍuṃ kavakāni ca |
abhakṣyāṇi dvijātīnām amedhyaprabhavāni ca || 5.5 ||
laśunādayaḥ padārthā loke prasiddhā eva | kavakaśabdo jātiśabdaḥ | kvacit kṛyākur iti prasiddhe 'rthe manyate | chatrākāni kavakāny eva | tathā hi kavakaśabdena pratiṣiddhaṃ chatrākaśabdena prāyaścittaṃ vakṣyati "chatrākaṃ viḍvarāhaṃ ca" iti (MDh 5.19) | na ca chatrākaṃ nāma padārthāntaraṃ prasiddham | na cākṣaravarṇasāmānyena yo yac chatrākāras taṃ taṃ chatrākam iti yuktaṃ pratipattum | tathā sati suvarcalādīnāṃ samācāravirodhī pratiṣedhaḥ prāpnoti | tasmād yāny eva kavakāni tāny eva chatrākāṇi | tathā ca niruktakāraḥ: "kṣuṇṇam ahicchatrakaṃ bhavati yat kṣudyate" (Nir 5.16) iti | tena[5] yāny etāni bhūmāv akṛṣṭāyām anupūrvajāyāṃ ca sitavarṇāni jāyante tāni ca kavakāni | vakṣyati ca "bhaumāni kavakāni" (MDh 6.14) iti | darśitaṃ ca "padā kṣuṇṇam iva" iti | pādaprahāreṇa yāni kṣudyante | yato yāni vṛkṣād gulmāj jāyante teṣāṃ tadākārāṇām pratiṣedhaḥ | kukuṇḍāni kavakāni vaidyake vyākhyātāni | etac ca vyākhyānaṃ na gavādiśabdavat | śāke[6] kavakaśabdo loke ca prayujyate | ato 'sya samācārād vaidyakādiśāstrārthe niścayaḥ | pradarśitaś cāsau | laśunādīnāṃ tu samānavarṇagandhā api viṣṇunā pratiṣiddhāḥ (ViDh 51.3) | pārāśarikāyāṃ tu śabdenaiva niṣedhaḥ prāyaścittaviśeṣārtha uktaḥ "cāndrāyaṇam" iti (cf. YDh 1.175) | tena lavatakakarṇikārādīnāṃ pratiṣedhaḥ | amedhyaprabhavāny amedhyajātāni ca saṃsargajātāni |
anye tv āhur mūlavāstūkavat kevalāmedhyaprabhavānāṃ yuktaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ | tataś ca yāny adhikapuṣṭyarthaṃ dhānyaśākādīny amedhyakṣetrajātāni saṃsṛjyante tāni na duṣyantīti |
tad ayuktam, śruteḥ[7] sarvasyāpy abhakṣyatvād | ihāpi ca yady amedhyasaṃsargam antareṇa na kiṃcid vastūtpadyate tataḥ syād api | yatas tu kiṃcin medhyāj jāyate kiṃcit saṃsṛṣṭāt tato 'yaṃ pratiṣedhaḥ kevale 'medhyaprabhave, na saṃsṛṣṭe, avatiṣṭhate |
māṃsasya saty api śukraśoṇitāmedhyaprabhavatve nāyaṃ pratiṣedhaḥ, pṛthakprakaraṇārambhāt tasya || 5.5 ||
lohitān vṛkṣaniryāsān vraścanaprabhavāṃs tathā |
śeluṃ gavyaṃ ca pīyūṣaṃ prayatnena vivarjayet || 5.6 ||
vṛkṣakoṭarasrāveṇa hetvantareṇa vā bahir yan mūlaskandhaphalapalāśaśākhākusumavyatiriktaṃ vṛkṣalagnaṃ jāyate sa vṛkṣaniryāsaḥ | lohitagrahaṇāt karpūrādīnām apratiṣedhaḥ | vraścanāc chedanād yeṣāṃ prabhavo janma | evaṃ vṛkṣāder valkapradeśā ye tatraiva[8] jāyante teṣām alohitānām apratiṣedhaḥ | śeluḥ śleṣmātakaḥ prasiddho vaidyakādiśāstrebhyaḥ | na tu sutasya kṣīrasya santānikā, aprasiddhatvāt | yat tu "pīyūṣasāhacaryāt[9] santānikā yuktā" iti, bhavati sāhacaryaṃ viśeṣahetur ubhayatra prayoge sati, na punaḥ sāhacaryam adṛṣṭaprayogāṇāṃ prayogajñāpakam | gavyaṃ ca | gavyagrahaṇān māhiṣāder apratiṣedhaḥ | anādyam[10] agnimātrasaṃyogāt piṇḍībhūtam anāsaktaṃ ca | sadyaḥprasūtāyā goḥ kṣīraṃ pīyūṣaśabdenocyate |
nanu ca kṣīrasya savikārasya daśāhaṃ cābhakṣyatāṃ vakṣyati | tricaturāṇi vāhāni tādṛśaṃ kṣīraṃ bhavati |
satyam | yadi kathaṃcit kasyāpi daśāhat pareṇa bhavati tad idam arthavat |
prayatnenetyādi padadvayaṃ ślokapūraṇārtham | abhakṣyāṇīty anuvartate || 5.6 ||
vṛthākṛsarasaṃyāvaṃ pāyasāpūpam eva ca |
anupākṛtamāṃsāni devānnāni havīṃṣi ca || 5.7 ||
atra kṛsarasaṃyāvam iti samāhāre dvandvaḥ | tilaiḥ saha siddha odanaḥ kṛsaraśabdenocyate | saṃyāvo bhojyaviśeṣaḥ sarpirguḍatilādikṛtaḥ pureṣu prasiddhaḥ |
ye tu yauter miśraṇārthatvād yāni miśrīkṛtyānnāni sādhyante mudgamakuṣṭhakādibhis[11] tāni saṃyāvaśabdenocyante iti teṣāṃ kṛsaragrahaṇam anarthakam | so 'pi hy anena prakāreṇa saṃyāva eva | vṛthāśabdaḥ sarvatrānuṣajyate | yad ātmārthaṃ kriyate, na devapitratithyartham | tadā kṛsarādīnām upadeśa iti |
tad ayuktam[12] | na hi gṛhasthā ekenārthena[13] pacanti[14] | haviṣa ivāvāpāt prabhṛti tādarthyenoddeśaḥ |[15] kiṃ tarhi anuddiṣṭaviśeṣasya sāmānyataḥ kṛtasyānnasya pañcayajñānuṣṭhānaṃ vihitam | tatrākṛtavaiśvadevasya bhojane vihitātikramaḥ, na punaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ samasti | tathā hi dve prāyaścitte bhavataḥ | vihitātikramāt pratiṣiddhasevanāc ca | kṛsarādayas tu devatāviseṣaṃ vāstuyajñādiviṣayam anuddiśya kṛtāś ced[16] āhnikavidhayo 'pi pratiṣidhyante |
yaś cāpi "nātmārthaṃ pacet" iti so 'py avaśyakartavyatvāt kṛtātikramasya[17] bhojanaprāptyanuvādo na punaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ | tathā sati dvimūlakalpanāprāyaścittaṃ syād ity uktam | na cānyārthatvenāpi kṛtasyātmārthatā pākasya niṣeddhuṃ śakyate | pacyamānārtho hi pākas tasya taddvārikā na śakyā ātmārthatā niṣeddhum, tenaiva vṛttividhānāt | na hi bhṛtyādiśiṣṭabhojanaṃ[18] gṛhasthasya śeṣasaṃskāro na cātra saṃkalpaḥ śruto yena madarthaṃ pacyatām iti pākakāle saṃkalpamātraṃ niṣidhyate | ātmārthaṃ cottarakālam avicāryety ucyate | mithyāsaṃkalpadoṣaś ca syāt | devatārthatayā saṃkalpitasyātmārthatayā yoga iti | tasmād ayam anuvādo yat pacen nātmārtham evopayojyaṃ prāg vidher vaiśvadevikād iti | tathā ca apakvabhojane 'pi vidhim etaṃ smaranti | "yadannaḥ puruṣo rājaṃs tadannās tasya devatāḥ" (Rām 2.95.31) iti | na ca bubhukṣamāṇasyaivādhikāraḥ, gārhasthyapratipattinimittatvāt | tena yad ahar na bhuñjīta tad ahar apy akurvan pratyavaiti |
etad uktaṃ bhavati | svārthaṃ vā pacatu parārthaṃ[19] vā pākṣīd iti sarvathā kṛtavaiśvadevātikramaṇavratā api na pravartante iti nityatām anuvadati | yac cāpi paṭhati |
laukike vaidike vāpi hutotsṛṣṭe jale kṣitau |
vaisvadevas tu kartavyaḥ pañcasūnāpanuttaye || iti |
anenāpi nityataivocyate | na hi vaidike vaiśvadevasaṃbhavaḥ | na ca smārtavacane pramāṇam asti |
pāyasāpūpam iti | payasā siddha odanaḥ pāyasḥ, na dadhyādipayovikāraḥ | apūpāḥ puroḍāśāḥ | devānnāni samācārapramāṇakāni | havīṃṣi śrutivihitāni hotavyāni — prāg grahahomād — yato haviḥśeṣasya bhakṣyatāṃ vakṣyati | anupākṛtasya ayajñātasya[20] paśor māṃsāni | upākaraṇaṃ paśoḥ saṃskāraviśeṣaḥ | sa paśuyāgeṣu vihitaḥ | etena ca yajñopayuktaśeṣabhakṣyatā māṃsasya lakṣyate | vṛthāśabdādhikāre 'py anupākṛtagrahaṇam atithyādiśiṣṭasyāpi go'vyajamāṃsasya pratiṣedhārtham | go'vyajamāṃsam eva vānupākṛtaśabdena vivakṣitam | go'vyajasyaiva tatrālambhaś codito yataḥ śiṣṭaṃ prokṣitam ity uktam[21] || 5.7 ||
anirdaśāyā goḥ kṣīram auṣṭram aikaśaphaṃ tathā |
āvikaṃ saṃdhinīkṣīraṃ vivatsāyāś ca goḥ payaḥ || 5.8 ||
yadīha "anirdaśāhaṃ goḥ kṣīram" iti pāṭhaḥ uṣṭrādīnām api dāśāhādikaḥ pratiṣedha āśaṅkyate | anirdaśāgrahaṇānuvṛttyā tatra samācāra ātyantikapratiṣedhārtha āśrayaṇīyaḥ | anirdaśāyā iti tu strīliṅgapāṭhe āśaṅkaiva nāsti | na hi taddhitāntair anirdaśāyā uṣṭram ityādibhiḥ saṃbandhopattiḥ | uttaratra ca punaḥ kṣīragrahaṇāt samācārāc ca uṣṭraikaśaphāvikānirdaśagavīkṣīrāṇi savikārāṇi pratiṣidhyante | saṃdhinīvivatsayos tu kṣīram eva |
anirdaśā ca gaur ucyate yasyāḥ prasūtāyā daśāhāny anatikrāntāni | saṃdhinī yā ubhayoḥ prāptadohā kathaṃcid anyatarasmin duhyate | prātaradugdhā[22] sāyaṃ duhyate | sā tu svalpakṣīratvād ekasminn eva kāle, sāsau saṃdhinī |
kaścid āha yā mṛtasvavatsā parakīyaṃ vatsaṃ saṃcārya duhyate sā saṃdhinī | vivatsā tu yā saty eva vatse vinākṛtavatsā vatsaprasravaṇam anapekṣya kuṣṭhakayavaśālituṣādinā bhojanaviśeṣeṇa duhyāt |
vivatsāyā iti | tenaiva vatsagrahaṇenāvatsā dhenur ānīyatām itivad gor iti labdhe gograhaṇam ajāmahiṣyor apratiṣedhārtham | na punar anirdaśāyā ity atra | ataś ca gograhaṇaṃ tatrājādyupalakṣaṇārtham | tathā ca gautamaḥ: "goś ca kṣīram anirdaśāyāh sūtake | ajāmahiṣyoś ca " (GDh 17.22–23) ity āha | payograhaṇaṃ saṃdhinīkṣīram iti samāsāntavartinaḥ kṣīrapadasya nātisukaraḥ saṃbandho yataḥ || 5.8 ||
āraṇyānāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ mṛgāṇāṃ māhiṣaṃ vinā |
strīkṣīraṃ caiva varjyāni sarvaśuktāni caiva hi || 5.9 ||
āraṇyā gohastimarkaṭādayaḥ | puṃsāṃ kṣīrābhāvaḥ | sarveṣāṃ mṛgāṇām iti jātimātravivakṣāyāṃ puṃliṅganirdeśasāmarthyāt strībhiḥ saṃbandhaḥ | mṛgakṣīraṃ kukkuṭāṇḍam itivat | darśitaṃ caitat puṃbhāvavidhau mahābhāṣyakāreṇa (Pat III: 157 on Pāṇ 8.3.42) | māhiṣaṃ vinā payo'pekṣayā napuṃsakanirdeśaḥ | strī mānuṣī | yady api "strī gauḥ somakrayaṇī" ityādau sāsnādimatyarthe prayogadarśanam, tathāpi jātyantarasyāprakṛtatvāt prasiddhataratvāt tatra prayogaḥ syāt | "striyo madhuram icchanti striyo ratnam anuttamam" iti nāry eva pratīyate | evakāram añjanādipratiṣedhe vyācakṣate | na kevalaṃ strīkṣīraṃ bhakṣaṇe varjyam, kiṃ tarhy anyāsv apy evaṃvidhāsu kriyāsu | eṣa tu smṛtyantarasamācārasāpekṣa eva śabdaḥ sūcako yuktaḥ, na tv asyārthasya vācakaḥ || 5.9 ||
dadhi bhakṣyaṃ ca śukteṣu sarvaṃ ca dadhisaṃbhavam |
yāni caivābhiṣūyante puṣpamūlaphalaiḥ śubhaiḥ || 5.10 ||
aviśeṣeṇa sarvaśukteṣu pratiṣiddheṣu keṣucid ayam apavādaḥ[23] | śuktāny ucyante yāni prāptasārasyāni[24] kālātyayena dravyāntarasaṃsargeṇa vāmlatām apadyante | yathāmrātakādīni madhurāṇi cirakālam atirasatvāc chuktāni bhavanti | niṣpīḍito madhurarasaḥ kālato 'mlatām etītyādinā evaṃvidhāni |[25] yāni tu svabhāvato 'mlāni dāḍimāmalakajambīrādīni tāni naiva śuktāni | yāni ca prāptakālotpattyādīni | na hy ayam āmlaparyāyaḥ śuktaśabdaḥ | tatra kevalāni pākataḥ śuktāni pratiṣidhyante | dravyāntaraiś ca puṣpamūlakādibhir yojitāny atra jñāyante | tathā ca gautamaḥ: "śuktaṃ kevalam adadhi" (GDh 17.14 ) |
abhiṣūyante | abhiṣava udakena saṃsṛjya parivāsanam |
yady evaṃ kāla eva tarhy amlatāhetuḥ |
satyam | etāny api dravyāṇi | tṛtīyā ca karaṇe sahayoge vā | puṣpādibhir udakena saha abhiṣūyante saṃdhīyante |
kecit tv āhuḥ | yatra puṣpamūlāṇy amlatām janayanti | yāni dāḍimāmalakādīni śuktāni tāni bhakṣyāṇi, yāni drākṣādibhir madhurair abhiṣūyante saṃdhīyante tāni na bhakṣyante | abhiṣavo hy ucyate śuktatājananam | yāni puṣpādibhiḥ śuktīkriyante | na ca drākṣādīni śuktatāpādakāni | kiṃ tarhi kevala eva kālaḥ |
etat tu na samyak, aśabdārthatvāt | na hi somam abhiṣuṇotīti śuktaṃ karotīti pratipattiḥ | kiṃ tarhi ya eva prāg vyākhyāto 'rthaḥ |
dadhisaṃbhavam udaśvinmastukilāṭakūrcikādi || 5.10 ||
kravyādaḥ śakunīn sarvān tathā grāmanivāsinaḥ |
anirdiṣṭāṃś caikaśaphaṃṣ ṭiṭṭibhaṃ ca vivarjayet || 5.11 ||
kravyāda āmamāṃsabhakṣakāḥ kaṅkagṛdhrādayaḥ | abhakṣyavat kevalāmamāṃsabhakṣakā gṛhyante | na tūbhayaraktā[26] mayūrādayaḥ | grāmanivāsinaḥ akravyādā api | ekaśaphā aśvāśvataragardabhādayaḥ | anirdiṣṭās tu na bhakṣyatvenoktās[27] te na bhakṣyā iti | ye tūktās tatraiva bhakṣyāḥ | ye tūṣṭravaḍavaṛkṣagauragardabhāḥ[28] prajākāmas teṣāṃ ca māṃsam aśnīyād iti |
nanu ca śrutita eva tatra bhakṣyāvāptiḥ | pratyuta nirdiṣṭagrahaṇe sati śrutau coditānām anyatra bhakṣyāśaṅkā, anidiṣṭān varjayen na nirdiṣṭān iti vākyārthapratipatteḥ | na ca smṛtau kecid bhakṣyatvena nirdiṣṭāḥ, yena tadvyatiriktaviṣayam anirdiṣṭagrahaṇaṃ vyākhyāyeta | ataḥ śrutau ye nirdiṣṭās te na bhakṣyā iti prāpnoti |
ucyate | ācārāvirodhī sa smṛtyarthaḥ | anirdiṣṭagrahaṇam anuvādaḥ |
ṭiṭṭibhaḥ śakunir eva, ṭiṭīti yo vāśate | prāyeṇa śabdānukaraṇanimittaṃ śakunīnāṃ nāmadheyapratilambhaḥ | taduktaṃ niruktakāreṇa: "kāka iti śabdānukṛtis tad idaṃ śakuniṣu bahulam" (Nir 3.18) iti || 5.11 ||
kalaviṅkaṃ plavaṃ haṃsaṃ cakrāhvaṃ grāmakukkuṭam |
sārasaṃ rajjudālaṃ ca dātyūhaṃ śukasārike || 5.12 ||
kalaviṅko grāmacaṭako nigameṣūktaḥ | grāmavāsitvāt tasya siddhe pratiṣedhe punaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ striyāś caṭakāyā abyanujñānārthaḥ | puṃśabdo hy ayaṃ vṛṣabavat |
anye tv āraṇyasya nivṛttyarthaṃ manyante | te hi varṣāsu vanavāsino bhavanti | bāhulayavyapadeśāc ca grāmacaṭakā ucyante | yathā mahiṣā āraṇyāḥ |
plavahaṃsacakravākānāṃ vakṣyamāṇajālapādapratiṣedhāt siddhe pratiṣedhe nityārthaṃ grahaṇam | ata āṭyādīnāṃ vikalpena bhakṣaṇaṃ gamyate | grāmakukkuṭam | grāmagrahaṇād āraṇyābhyanujñānam |
kutaḥ punar āraṇyasyābhakṣyatāśaṅkā |
smṛtyantare hi "kukkuṭo vikirāṇām" (ĀpDh 1.17.32) iti paṭhyate | ataś cāviśeṣeṇābhakṣyatā prāptā, vacanena tasya sāmānyapratiṣedhasya viśiṣṭaviṣayatā prajñāyate |
nanu vikalpaḥ kasmān na bhavaty[29] anena śāstreṇāsyābhyanujñānāc chāstrāntareṇa cāviśeṣeṇa tasyāpi pratiṣedhāt |
nāyaṃ vikalpasya viṣayaḥ | virodhe hi tulyabalānāṃ vikalpo na cātra virodho 'sti | na hy anayoḥ smṛtyoḥ śāstrabhedo 'pi, sāmānyasya viśeṣa upasaṃhartuṃ nyāyyatvāt, śākhāntaratas tṛtīyasyāpy ekaśāstrasya darśitatvāt |
yady evaṃ jālapādapratiṣedhasyāpi haṃsādiviśeṣa evopasaṃhāro yukto nāviśeṣeṇa kākajālapādānāṃ sarveṣāṃ pratiṣedhaḥ |
bhaved evaṃ yady apauruṣeyo 'yaṃ granthaḥ syāt | bhinnakartṛke tv apauruṣeyatve na sāmānyasya[30] kiṃcit prayojanaṃ haṃsādiviśeṣamātraparyavasāne | bhinnakartṛkatve tu[31] pauruṣeyatve sati sāmānyadarśino viśeṣaviṣayam ajñānaṃ saṃbhavati, viśeṣadarśino 'pi sāmānyaviṣayam[32] | ubhayoś ca mūlakalpanāyām ekasya sāmānyavedanaṃ vacanamūlaṃ kalpyate, anyasya viśeṣavacanam | tayoś ca vaidikayor bhinnaśākhādītayor asati śāstrabhede, ekavākyataiva nyāyyā | na ca vede paryanuyogo 'sti, kiṃ sāmānyena yadi viśeṣaniṣṭhatā, tasya kartur abhāvāt | śrutād dhi tatra pratipattiḥ kevalaśabdaśaktisamāśritā | na prayojanavaśenārthāntarakalpanam |
rajjudālādayaḥ śākunikebhya upalabdhavyāḥ || 5.12 ||
pratudān jālapādāṃś ca koyaṣṭinakhaviṣkirān |
nimajjataś ca matsyādān saunaṃ vallūram eva ca || 5.13 ||
pratudya prahṛtya cañcvā ye bhakṣayanti | svabhāva eṣa eṣāṃ pakṣiṇām | pratudāḥ śatapatrādayaḥ | jālapādā āṭyādayaḥ | teṣāṃ vikalpa uktaḥ |
nanu ca yatra vikalpa anyataratrecchātaḥ[33] pravṛttiḥ | sā cāpratiṣiddheṣv api sthitaiva | laukikaṃ hi bhakṣaṇam, tat saty evārthitve | na śāstrīyam, yena niyamataḥ syāt | tatra vikalpitasya pratiṣedhasya na kiṃcit prayojanaṃ paśyāmaḥ |
ucyate | dattottaram etat |
yatrābuddhipūrvaprayogāc chabdād evārthāvagatiḥ | pauruṣeyas tv ayaṃ granthaḥ samāhitacetasā prayatnavatā śatasāhasrikaṃ saṃkṣeptum ācāryeṇa praṇītaḥ, yatrāśakyam anarthakaṃ prayoktum | ata ācāryābhidhānam unnīyate | na tu[34] jālapādapratiṣedhe 'sati tadviśeṣaṃ[35] haṃsaṃ svaśabdena niṣedhayati | yata etad api smaraṇam eva |
anye tv anyena jālapādas tv iti pramādapāṭhaḥ syāt |
uktaṃ caitad iṅgitena ceṣṭitena mahatā vā sūtrapraṇayanenācāryāṇām abhiprāyā lakṣyante | viśeṣaś cātrānumīyate | "jālapādādi[36] na bhakṣayet"it vivakṣate sāmānyapratiṣedha ubhayor arthavattvāya |
yatra māṃsavikrayārthāḥ paśavo hanyante sā sūnā | āpaṇo māṃsasyety eke | vallūraṃ māṃsaṃ saṃśoṣya cirasthāpitam | nakhair vikīrya bhakṣayanti te nakhaviṣkirāḥ | mayūrabalākādayaḥ | "āpatsu" (MDh 11.28) iti vacanāt tu teṣāṃ pākṣikī bhakṣyāpy asti | sa hi paṭhati "kukkuṭo vikirāṇām" (ĀpDh 1.17.32) iti | na cāsya mānavasya vacanasya kukkuṭopasaṃhāraḥ śakyo vaktuṃ kukkuṭanāmagrahaṇasyānarthakaprasaṅgāt || 5.13 ||
bakaṃ caiva balākāṃ ca kākolaṃ khañjarīṭakam |
matsyādān viḍvarāhāṃś ca matsyān eva ca sarvaśaḥ || 5.14 ||
bakabalākākākolādīnāṃ[37] matsyādagraṇāt siddhe pratiṣedhe tadanyeṣāṃ vikalpārthaṃ punarvacanam | matsyādā apakṣiṇo 'pi matsyādagrahaṇād abhakṣyā vijñeyāḥ nakrādayaḥ, kriyānimittatvān matsyādaśabdasya | kākolaś ca śyeno deśāntaraprasiddheḥ, ayaṃ bāhlīkeṣv evam ucyata iti prasiddham | viḍvarāhapratiṣedhāc cāraṇyābhyanujñā[38] grāmavāsipratiṣedhaś ca[39] pūrvasūtre prakaraṇāc chakuniviśeṣaṇārtho vijñeyaḥ | evaṃ hi ceha viḍvarāhagrahaṇam arthavad bhavati | grāmavāsī śūkaro viḍvarāhaḥ |
nanu ca yadi tatra prakaraṇād grāmavāsinaḥ[40] pakṣiṇo gṛhyante, ihāpi matsyādāḥ pakṣiṇa eva grahītuṃ nyāyyāḥ |
naivam | na cātra śakunīnāṃ prakaraṇam asti viḍvarāhamatsyānām apakṣiṇām[41] api nirdeśārtham |
sarvaśaḥ sarvadā | utsargo 'yam | asyāpavādaṃ vakṣyāmaḥ || 5.14 ||
yo yasya māṃsam aśnāti sa tanmāṃsāda ucyate |
matsyādaḥ sarvamāṃsādas tasmān matsyān vivarjayet || 5.15 ||
pūrvasya matsyapratiṣedhavidher arthavādo 'yam | yatsaṃbandhimāṃsaṃ yo 'śnāti sa tanmāṃsasaṃbandhinyāśanakriyayā vyapadiśyate | yathā sarpādo nakulaḥ, mārjāro mūṣakāda ityādi | yas tu matsyādaḥ sa sarvamāṃsāśī bhavati | gomāṃsāda[42] ity api vyapadeṣṭuṃ yuktaḥ | ato nindātiśayān matsyān vivarjayet || 5.15 ||
pāṭhīnarohitāv ādyau niyuktau havyakavyayoḥ |
rājīvāḥ siṃhatuṇḍāṃś ca saśalkāś[43] caiva sarvaśaḥ || 5.16 ||
pāṭhīnarohitau matsyajātiviśeṣau tayor havyakavyaniyogena śrāddhādau bhakṣyatābhyanujñāyate, nānvāhike bhojane | rājīvasiṃhatuṇḍasaśalkānāṃ sarvaśaḥ havyakavyābhyām anyatrāpy anivṛttir bhojane | rājīvāḥ padmavarṇāḥ kaiścid iṣyante | aparais tu rājayo rekhā[44] yeṣāṃ santi | siṃhatuṇḍāh siṃhakṛtimukhāḥ | saśalkāḥ śakalinaḥ || 5.16 ||
na bhakṣayed ekacarān ajñātāṃś ca mṛgadvijān |
bhakṣyeṣv api samuddiṣṭān sarvān pañcanakhāṃs tathā || 5.17 ||
ekacarāḥ sarpolūkādaya ekākinaś caranti | ajñātān nāmato jātiviśeṣataś ca | mṛgadvijān | mṛgāḥ pakṣiṇaś ca na bhakṣyāḥ | bhakṣyeṣv api samuddiṣṭān | ye pratiṣiddhās te tādrūpye asati bhakṣyatāṃ prāptāḥ samuddiṣṭā iva bhavanti | na tu bhakṣyāṇāṃ samuddeśo 'sti | parihartavyatayā viśeṣato 'vijñātā bhakṣypakṣapatitā[45] bhakṣyeṣv api samuddiṣṭā ity evam ucyante | pañcanakhāś ca vānaraśṛgālādayaḥ | sarvagrahaṇaṃ pādapūraṇārtham || 5.17 ||
śvāvidhaṃ śalyakaṃ godhāṃ khaḍgakūrmaśaśāṃs tathā |
bhakṣyān pañcanakheṣv āhur anuṣṭrāṃś caikatodataḥ || 5.18 ||
pañcanakhānāṃ madhyāc chvāvidhādayo[46] bhakṣyāḥ | smṛtyantare tu khaḍge vikalpaḥ | tathā ca vasiṣṭhaḥ: "khaḍge tu vivadante" iti (VaDh 14.47) | uṣṭravarjitā ekatodato go'vyajamṛgā bhakṣyāḥ |
nanu ca śvāvitprabhṛtīnāṃ pañcanakhānāṃ bhakṣyatvavacanād anyeṣām abhakṣyatāsiddheḥ "sarvān pañcanakhān" (MDh 5.17) iti pratiṣedhavacanam anarthakam |
naiṣa doṣaḥ | sarvaśabdena pratiṣedhe spaṣṭā pratipattir bhavati | bhakṣyaviśeṣanirdeśena tadanyeṣāṃ yā abhakṣyatāpratipattiḥ sā ānumānikī pratipattiḥ | gauravaṃ hi tathā syāt || 5.18 ||
chatrākaṃ viḍvarāhaṃ ca laśunaṃ grāmakukkuṭam |
palāṇḍuṃ gṛñjanaṃ caiva matyā jagdhvā pated dvijaḥ || 5.19 ||
chatrākaṃ kavakāni | viḍvarāhaḥ grāmaśūkaraḥ svatantraviharaḥ | etāni bhakṣayitvā patito bhavet | patitaprāyaścittaṃ kuryāt | vakṣyati ca "garhitānnādyayor jagdhiḥ surāpānasamāni ṣaṭ" (MDh 11.55) || 5.19 ||
amatyaitāni ṣaḍ jagdhvā kṛcchraṃ sāntapanaṃ caret |
yaticāndrāyaṇaṃ vāpi śeṣeṣūpavased ahaḥ || 5.20 ||
amatyā abuddhipūrvaṃ ṣaṭ jagdhvā ṣaṇṇām anyatamam api | bhakṣaṇasya avidheyatvanimittatayā sāhityasyāvivakṣā | śeṣeṣu abhakṣyeṣu bhakṣaṇe lohitavṛkṣaniryāsādiṣu ekam ahorātraṃ na bhuñjīta | ahaḥśabdo rātrāv api dṛṣṭaprayogaḥ | "ahaś ca kṛṣṇam ahar arjunaṃ ca" (RV 6.9.1) iti | yeṣu cātra prakaraṇe pratiṣiddheṣu prāyaścittādhikāre pratipadaṃ prāyaścittam anyad vakṣyate "kravyādasūkara" (MDh 11.155) ityādi tatra tad eva draṣṭavyaṃ pratipadavihitatvāt, asya copavāsasyānyatra caritārthatvāt || 5.20 ||
saṃvatsarasyaikam api caret kṛcchraṃ dvijottamaḥ |
ajñātabhuktaśuddhyarthaṃ jñātasya tu viśeṣataḥ || 5.21 ||
bhojyaśūdragṛhabhojino brāhmaṇasyedam ucyate | yasya śūdrasya gṛhe yāni brāhmaṇānām abhojyāny annāni saṃbhavanti, na dūrataḥ parihriyante, tādṛśasya gṛhe yo brāhmaṇo 'nnaṃ bhuṅkte tasya pratiṣiddhānnabhojanāśaṅkāyāṃ prājāpatyakṛcchracaraṇam upadiśyate | aviśeṣanodanāyāṃ prājāpatyaṃ kṛcchraṃ pratīyata iti vakṣyāmaḥ |
ajñātabhuktaśuddhyartham ajñātadoṣaśaṅkāyām āha | doṣo yadi bhuṅkte tasya śuddhyartham |
nanu ca īdṛśasya śuddhiṃ vakṣyati: "adṛṣṭam adbhir nirṇiktam" iti (MDh 5.125) | tasya viṣayaṃ tatraiva darśayiṣyāmaḥ |
jñātasya tu doṣasya viśeṣataḥ vaiśeṣikaṃ prāyaścittaṃ kartavyam, yasya yad vihitaṃ pratipadam || 5.21 ||
yajñārthaṃ brāhmaṇair vadhyāḥ praśastā mṛgapakṣiṇaḥ |
bhṛtyānāṃ caiva vṛttyartham agastyo hy ācarat purā || 5.22 ||
bhakṣyaprasaṅgena hiṃsābhyanujñāyate | atyarthaṃ kṣutpīṣāyāṃ bhṛtyāder bhojanāntarāsaṃbhave bhakṣyamṛgapakṣivadhaḥ kartavyaḥ | bhṛtyāḥ prāg vyākhyātāḥ | agastyas tathākṛtavān ity agastyagrahaṇaṃ praśaṃsārtham | yajñārtham ityādyo 'rdhaśloko 'rthavāda eva | tatra hi vadhaḥ pratyakṣaśrutivihitatvād eva siddhaḥ | praśastā ye bhakṣyatayānujñātāḥ | eṣa evārtha uttaraśloke vistarataḥ karmārthavādatayā kathyate || 5.22 ||
babhūvur hi puroḍāśā bhakṣyāṇāṃ mṛgapakṣiṇām
purāṇeṣv ṛṣiyajñeṣu brahmakṣatrasaveṣu ca || 5.23 ||
ṣaṭviṃśatsaṃvatsaraṃ nāma satram | tatra mṛgapakṣivadha āmnātaḥ | so 'nenānūdyate | idaṃ tatra brāhmaṇam: "saṃsthite 'hani gṛhapatir mṛgayāṃ yāti sa tatra yān yān mṛgān hanti teṣāṃ tarasāḥ puroṣāśā bhavanti" (ĀpŚ 23.11.12–13) | arthavādatvād babhūvur iti bhūtapratyaye na vivakṣā | tenādyatve 'pi bhavanti | evaṃ purāṇeṣv api | na kevalaṃ kaścid adyatve satrāṇāṃ vyavahāra iti darśanābhiprāyam etat purāṇeṣv iti | na punar adyatve yadi kecit sarvāṇy eva hareyuḥ.[47] teṣām eṣa vidhir na bhavatīti mantavyam | atha vā yaḥ svayaṃ śāstrārthaṃ veditum asamarthaḥ kevalaṃ paraprasiddhyā "mahājano yena gataḥ sa panthāḥ" (MBh 3. App. 32.68) iti nyāyena pravartate, tatra tv etad ucyate: purāṇeṣv iti | nāyam idaṃprathamako dharmaḥ | kiṃ tarhi, anādiḥ | purāṇā[48] ṛṣayo brāhmaṇāḥ kecana tapaḥsiddhāḥ, jātyantaraṃ vā | yathā mahābhāratādau varṇitam | na cātra nirbandhaḥ kartavyaḥ: "ṛṣīṇāṃ jātyantaratve gandharvādivat kathaṃ yāgeṣv adhikāraḥ" iti | yato 'yam arthavādo yena kenacid ālambanena pratīyate | brahmakṣatrasavāḥ brahmakṣatriyayajñāḥ || 5.23 ||
yat kiṃcit snehasaṃyuktaṃ bhakṣyaṃ bhojyam agarhitam |
tat paryuṣitam apy ādyaṃ haviḥśeṣaṃ ca yad bhavet || 5.24 ||
bhakṣyaṃ yat kiṃcit snehasaṃyuktam | bhojyam odanādi | bhuktibhujyor ekārthatve 'pi pṛthagupādānād viṣayabhedo 'yaṃ pratīyate | agarhitaṃ śuktatām anāpannam | tat paryuṣitam apy ādyam | rātryantare paryuṣitam ucyate | pūrvedyuḥ siddham apy aparedyuḥ paryuṣitaṃ bhavati | snehasaṃyuktam iti | evaṃ saṃdihyate | kiṃ yat snehasaṃyuktaṃ sat paryuṣitaṃ rasamiśraśākādi tat paryuṣitam aśitavyam, uta śuṣkasyāpi[49] paryuṣitasya bhakṣaṇakāle[50] snehasaṃyogaḥ kartavyaḥ | bhakṣāpūpādy api paryuṣitaṃ bhojanakāle snehena saṃyojya bhakṣayitavyam iti |
atra saṃdihyate:[51] snehayuktānāṃ bhakṣyatocyate tat paryuṣitam ādyam iti | uddiśyamānaṃ snehasaṃyuktam[52] nipatanaṃ na punar vidheyārthe | na hi tacchabdasaṃbandho 'sya śruto yat paryuṣitaṃ tat[53] snehasaṃyuktam ādyam iti |
ucyate | haviḥśeṣāṇāṃ paryuṣitānām asnehasaṃyuktānāṃ teṣāṃ vacanam anartham | na ca teṣāṃ snehasaṃyuktānāṃ parivāsaḥ saṃbhavati | evaṃ ca teṣāṃ vacanam arthavad bhavati yadi bhojanakāle teṣāṃ snehasaṃyogo nāpekṣyate | atas teṣāṃ tāvad bhojanakāla eva snehasaṃyoganirapekṣatayā vacanasyārthavattvam |
yady evaṃ tathāpi na saṃdehaḥ | arthavattvād viśeṣapadasya vidheyarthatā snehasaṃyuktaśabdasya[54] nyāyyā |
ucyate | etāvad atra saṃdehe bījam | yathāśrutasaṃbandhasya balīyastvāt kiṃ haviḥśeṣapadam anuvādo 'stu utānarthanakatvaṃ mā prāpad iti yat paryuṣitaṃ tena snehasaṃbandhaḥ kriyatām | tatrānarthakyād vyavahitakalpanā jyāyasī | samācārān nirṇayaḥ |
sarpistailavasāmajjāḥ snehāḥ || 5.24 ||
cirasthitam api tv ādyam asnehāktaṃ dvijātibhiḥ |
yavagodhūmajaṃ sarvaṃ payasaś caiva vikriyā || 5.25 ||
cirasthitaṃ dvirātrādyantaritam | apiśabdād āktam ity atrāpi saṃbandhayitavyam | snehāktam api yavagodhūmajaṃ saktvapūpādi | payaso vikriyā vikārā dahimathitādayaḥ || 5.25 ||
etad uktaṃ dvijātīnāṃ bhakṣyābhakṣyam aśeṣataḥ |
māṃsasyātaḥ pravakṣyāmi vidhiṃ bhakṣaṇavarjane || 5.26 ||
ādyena ślokārdhena pūrvaprakaraṇam avacchinatti | tad etad anantaram anukrāntaṃ prakaraṇam etat[55] dvijātīnāṃ na śūdrāṇām iti, uttaraṃ tu yad vakṣyate tac chūdrāṇām apīti prakaraṇavyavacchedaprayojanam |
ataś ca māṃsabhakṣaṇe prakāro vakṣyate | yac ca tadvarjanena phalaṃ tac chūdrasyāpi bhavatīti | anyathā "abhakṣyāṇi dvijātīnām" (MDh 5.5) ity adhikārāl laśunādiṣv iva[56] śūdrasya māṃsabhakṣaṇe 'pi kāmacāraḥ syāt |
yady evaṃ devādyarcane śiṣṭasya māṃsasya bhakṣyatā vakṣyate: "devān pitṝṃś cārcayitvā khādan māṃsaṃ na duṣyati" (MDh 5.32) iti | devādyarcanaṃ medhyena māṃsena | ye ca dvijātīnāṃ pratiṣiddhā mṛgaśakuntās te 'medhyāḥ | ataś ca teṣāṃ māṃsena devārcanāsaṃbhavād ataccheṣasyābhakṣyatvād[57] anye 'pi prakaraṇabhedāḥ, yathā brāhmaṇādīnāṃ mṛgapakṣiṇaḥ pratiṣiddhāḥ, te śūdrasyāpi prakārāntareṇa pratiṣiddhā bhavanti | tatra prakaraṇabhedena na kiṃcid[58] ucyate | laśunādipratiṣedhaḥ śūdrasya na bhavati |
asti tāvat prakaraṇabhedena prayojanaṃ laśunādipratiṣedhe śūdrasyādhikāro mā bhūd iti | māṃse 'pi devādyarcane gṛhasthasyādhikārād agṛhasthasya śūdrasya yathākāmyam |
nanu ca pākayajñe śūdrasyādhikārataḥ sthita eva[59] | bhojanaṃ gṛhasthānāṃ ca vihitam | na ca laśunādibhiḥ pākayajñāḥ kriyante | tataś ca nāpi śūdrasya yathākāmyaṃ laśunādayo bhakṣyāḥ syuḥ |
ko doṣaḥ |
dvijātigrahaṇam anarthakam |
parihṛtam etad agṛhasthasya proṣitasya vā kāmacāraḥ | na ca gṛhasthena yad ahutaṃ tan na bhoktavyam | "śeṣabhug bhavet" (MDh 3.107) ity asyāyam arthaḥ: akṛtavaiśvadevakriyeṇa na bhoktavyam | tatra yasyaiva yāgasādhanatā dravyasya tad eva medhyaṃ hotavyam | anye tu bhojanakāle kutaścid āhṛtya madhyagehe vā bhujyate | tac cāhutaśeṣam[60] api na pratiṣiddham | māṃse tu punarvacanān niyamaḥ: na kadācid devānupayuktaṃ bhojyam iti |
yadi cāturvarṇyasyātrādhikāras tadā yad vakṣyati parastāt[61] śuddhavidhau "caturṇām api varṇānām" (MDh 5.57) iti tad anarthakam |
tatraiva tasya prayojanaṃ vakṣyāmaḥ |
atha śvamāṃsādy apy śūdrasya bhakṣyaṃ prāpnoti dvijātigrahaṇāt pūrvatra |
kiṃ tv ekādaśe "viḍvarāhakharoṣṭrāṇām" ityādiślokatrayanirdiṣṭāḥ (MDh 11.153–55) śūdrasyāpi na bhakṣyā iti jñāpakaṃ darśayiṣyāmaḥ || 5.26 ||
prokṣitaṃ bhakṣayen māṃsaṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ ca kāmyayā |
yathāvidhi niyuktas tu prāṇānām eva cātyaye || 5.27 ||
agnīṣomīye paśau hutaśiṣṭaṃ māṃsaṃ lakṣaṇayā prokṣitam ucyate |
nanu prokṣitaśabdo yaugika ukṣasecana ity asya dhātoḥ prakṣālanakriyānimittakaḥ | tathā ca "prokṣaṇīr āsādaya," "ghṛtaṃ prokṣaṇīyam" iti, "prokṣaṇībhir udvejitāḥ stha" iti sarvatra kriyāyogāt prayujyate | yady āsecanasādhanam, tatra kuto vaidikasaṃskāranimittakānāṃ svasaṃbandhe paśulakṣaṇādvāreṇa māṃse pravartate | mukhyaṃ ca śabdārtham atikramya kim iti lakṣaṇāśrīyate | ataḥ prakṣālitam udakādinā[62] yuktam |
satyam, yady atra vākyāntarāṇy arthavādāś ca śeṣabhūtā[63] na syuḥ: "anupākṛtamāṃsāni" (YDh 1.170), "asaṃskṛtān paśūn mantraiḥ" (MDh 5.36) iti | atas tatparyālocanayāyam evārtho 'vatiṣṭhate |
yady evaṃ tata eva siddhatvāt kim anena |
kecid āhuḥ anuvado 'yam | māṃsecchayā bhakṣaṇasya vidhis tāvad ayaṃ na bhavati kṣutpratighātārthino lipsayā pravṛttyupapatteḥ | sa hi vidhir ucyate yaḥ puruṣasya dṛṣṭena prayojanena pravṛttāv asatyāṃ pravṛttyavabodhakaḥ: "yāvijjīvam agnihotraṃ juhuyāt" iti | śāstram evātra pramāṇam | yatra "asmin kṛte idam abhimatam abhinirvartate[64], akṛte vāyam anartha āpatati" evam anvayavyatirekābhyām avagamyate tatra śāstram eva mṛgyate | yatra tu nāyam anyato 'vagamaḥ[65] kevalāgamaikagocaraḥ[66] sa vidhir iti cocyate | iha tu bhojane kṛte puṣṭir upajāyate, yad duḥkhaṃ tan nivartata iti, bālā api stanapāyino 'nupadiṣṭam avayanti | niyamo 'pi bhavati, tadrūpānavadhāraṇāt | yadi tāvat prokṣitaṃ ca bhakṣayed eveti niyamas tadā kālaviśeṣāvacchedābhāvād āhāravihārakālā apy avasīdeyur anavaratam aśnann evāsīta, aśakyaś cārtha upadiṣṭaḥ syāt | yathoktam "aśrāddhabhojī" iti, "yad ahar eva pratyaveyāt" iti | mahābhāṣyakāreṇa vidhiviśeṣa eva ca niyama uktaḥ | asaṃbhavati ca vidhau kuto niyamaḥ | na cānyena prokṣitam anyena labhyeta | tasmād ayam anarthaḥ | atha prokṣitam eveti aprokṣitaṃ neti parisaṃkhyā | na hi prokṣitāprokṣitobhayabhakṣaṇasya tyāgād aśanāyā nivṛttau yugapat paryāyeṇa vā pravṛttyā parisaṃkhyālakṣaṇasya vidyamānatvāt | tathāpy "anupākṛtamāṃsāni" (YDh 1.170) ity eva siddham |
anye tv asya pakṣasyaivaṃ doṣam upapādayante | aviśeṣeṇa[67] sarvāprokṣītapratiṣedhe[68] śakunīnām api pratiṣedhaḥ prāpnoti | na ca yeṣām eva prokṣaṇaṃ vihitaṃ teṣāṃ tu pratividhānādyabhāvād iti na viśeṣaparigrahe pramāṇam asti |
tad ayuktaṃ manyante | evaṃ sati bhedena śakunīnāṃ pratiṣedhānukrameṇa, gamakatvāt |
tasmāc chrutakarmāṅgatvena[69] niyamasya prokṣitamāṃsabhakṣaṇasyāyam anuvāda iti yuktaṃ dṛṣṭāntatayā | yathā yajñe 'vaśyaṃ bhakṣaṇam, abhakṣaṇāc chāstrātikramaḥ, evam uttareṣv api nimitteṣu | anuvādaś cet parisaṃkhyāpekṣāpy astu | go'vyajamāṃsam aprokṣitaṃ na[70] bhakṣayed ity ananaitad anupākṛtānām evāsadrūpam anūdyate, aprokṣitasyāpi brāhmaṇakāmyādinimitteṣv anujñāpanārthaḥ |
anyac ca "anarcitaṃ vṛthāmāṃsam api" (MDh 4.213) cāturthikena vṛthāmāṃsaśabdena etad anuparijñānārtham itarathā na[71] vijñāyeta kiṃ tad vṛthāmāṃsam iti | atha vā ekatra bhoktur upadeśo 'nyatra kalpayitvā yena devādyarcanaṃ na[72] kṛtaṃ tadīyaṃ māṃsam anyenāpy atithyādinā na bhoktavyam | anadhikṛtenāpi devādyarcanena hy atithyādayaḥ paragṛhe tadīyena māṃsena devārcane 'dhikriyate | atha kalpayitvā yadi kṛtaṃ tadārhaty aśitum | dvitīyas tu praṣedho "devān pitṝn" (MDh 5.32) iti svagṛhe 'dhikṛtānām akṛtavatāṃ bhakṣaṇāya | yas tarhi[73] "asaṃskṛtān paśūn mantraiḥ" (MDh 5.36) iti sa[74] uktaḥ prokṣaṇaśabdārthaḥ | evaṃ pañcāpi niṣedhavākyāni pṛthagarthāni darśitāni |
brāhmaṇānāṃ ca kāmyayā | kāmyā[75] kāmanā icchā | kāmyāśabdaḥ chāndasaḥ |
yadā brāhmaṇādīnām aprokṣitānām idam anujñānam, tadā kiṃ punar ayaṃ niyamaḥ | abhakṣaṇe śāstrātikramaḥ | uta pratiprasavamātram | pratiprasave bhoktavyaṃ vivāhe punar bhoktavyam iti vacanād api pratiṣedhāpravṛttir[76] vivāhe gamyate |
na bhojanārtham āvaśyakaṃ kiṃ tu brāhmaṇā yadi garīyāṃsas tadā tadvacanātikramo na yuktaḥ |
anye tu "krītvādi"śloke (MDh 5.32) brāhmaṇānām ity anuvartya śaśādimāṃsasyāpi vidhim icchanti | yajñavivāhayor anyatra ca goṣṭhībhojanādau yadi brāhmaṇā arthayante tadā teṣāṃ māṃsaṃ svarūpeṇa devauddeśikayā na pratiṣiddham, avasthāviśeṣeṇa prokṣaṇam devārcanādīni kartavyāni | viśeṣaḥ pratiṣiddhaḥ | tasya brāhmaṇakāmanānimittata abhyanujñātā[77], na tu[78] "kravyādān śakunān" ityādeḥ pratiṣedhasya[79] "nivṛttis tu mahāphalā" (MDh 5.11) iti kṛtasaṃkalpas tasyāpy anujñānam iṣyate, prokṣite 'prokṣite ca kṛtārcane 'kṛtārcane vā |
yathāvidhiniyukta tu prāṇānām eva cātyaye | madhuparke ca śrāddhe ca niyukto 'prokṣaṇenāpi bhakṣayet | eṣa hi yathāśāstraṃ niyogas tatra śrāddhe niyamā uktā eva | "ketitas tu yathānyāyam", "kathaṃcid apy atikrāman" (MDh 3.180) iti | śrāddhaṃ bhokṣya ity abhyupatyedam ahaṃ nāśnāmīti na labhyate vaktum, abhakṣyam aśucikaraṃ vyādhijananaṃ ca varjayitvā, haviṣyavidhānān na bhakṣyaṃ yad yad rocate tat tan nāprītikaraṃ dīyate | ata idaṃ vacanaṃ madhuparka eva |
nanu madhuparke nāsti niyogaḥ |
aśitavyaṃ madhuparkārheṇeti[80] niyamaḥ, nāsau madhuparkasya vidhiḥ | sa hi tatrādhikṛto na dhanyo rājādiḥ | yathaiva "nāsyānaśnan gṛhe vaset" (MDh 3.95) iti gṛhasthasya niyamo dṛśyate | etenāvagamyate amatike na dātavyam iti | yais tu kāmacāra evaṃ pūjitasamādānena pūjyasyāśanena, na hi tat tadarthaṃ karma |
nanu cātithyam evānityam |
satyam | dṛṣṭaṃ prītyutpādanena[81] dharmārtham anuṣṭhānam | tasya niyamoktadharmārtham eva dātus tasya hi gor utsargapakṣe vihito "nāmāṃso madhuparkaḥ syāt" iti |
nanv ārtvijye[82] vacanasyāpi viṣaya iti cet |
astv ayam api pūrvavad anuvādaḥ śrāddhe ārtvijye ca |
nanu cārtvijye uktam eva iḍādibhakṣaṇaṃ yajamānasya tatra śāstranibandhano niyamaḥ, nartvijām |
satyam | kiṃ tu ṛtvijo yadi na bhakṣayanti te pravādyante | aviditena adṛṣṭenāpi doṣeṇa yujyante |
nanu teṣāṃ bhakṣaṇam adhikṛtānām āstām[83] | na hi te karmaphalena yujyante | bhṛtyādir hi parikrīto vihitān[84] padārthān anutiṣṭhati | vihitaś ca "yajamānapañcamā iḍāṃ[85] bhakṣayanti" iti | teṣāṃ bhakaṣaṇato 'syābhyupagatārtvijyānāṃ niyataṃ bhakṣaṇaṃ tadā tenānūdyata iti yuktam | na hi śrāddhabhujām ṛtvijāṃ ca bhakṣaṇe śāstrīyayogaḥ | yajamānasyaivānuvādaḥ kimartha iti cen, nānuvādaḥ prayojanam apekṣate | kiṃ tarhi prāptam asti cātrocyate | atrāpi yadā gopena govadhapūjābhyupagatā tadāvaśyam aśitavyam | tadanugrahārtham asau madhuparkapūjāṃ pratīkṣati[86] | ataḥ pūrvā tena kriyā saṃpādanīyā | anyathā prākramikasyābhāvād aparpūrṇena[87] madhupareṇa tadanugrahāsampattes tasmin pratiṣiddhamāṃsāśane madhuparkapūjārtvijyaṃ ca prathamam evābhyupagantavyam | brāhmaṇabhojane ca | brahmacāriṇas tu vratavad ity anujñānād anaśanam eva[88] grāhyaṃ māṃsasya |
prāṇānām eva cātyaye | prakṛtatvād devādyarcanam antareṇa abhakṣyamāṇe vyādhinā kṣudhā bhojanāntarāsaṃbhave jīvanāśaśaṅkāyāṃ go'jāvi bhakṣayitavyam | "sarvata evātmānaṃ gopāyet" (GDh 9.34) ity etacchrutimūlo 'yaṃ niyamaḥ | ataś cedṛśe nimitte māṃsam anaśnann[89] ātmahā saṃpadyate | ātmavadhaś ca "sarvata evātmānaṃ gopāyet" (GDh 9.34). "tasmād u ha na purāyuṣaḥ svaḥkāmī preyād alokyaṃ hy etad bhavati" (ŚB 10.2.6.7) ityādiśrutibhir mantrārthavādaiś ca tair doṣavān neti jñāpitaḥ | tathāhi mantraḥ:
asuryā nāma te lokā andhena tamasāvṛtāḥ |
tāṃs te pretyābhigacchanti ye ke cātmahano janāḥ || iti | (ĪśU 3)
brahmacāriṇo 'pi prāṇātyaye bhakṣaṇam iṣyate | tasyaiva bālyādyavasthānimittaṃ vācanikaṃ prāyaścittaṃ bhaviṣyatīti: "brahmacārī tu yo 'śnīyān madhu māṃsaṃ kadācana" (MDh 11.157) iti | kṣudhā tu prāṇātyayāśaṅkāyāṃ pratiṣiddhamāṃsāśanam apīti vyāsaḥ (VeSū 3.4.28) | jāghanīnidarśanenaikāhikaṃ ceṣyate | etāvatā[90] atītavyādhau tu na śakyam etat jñātum avaśyam aśitenānena jīvatīti | tatra na pratiṣiddhagrāmyakukkuṭādimāṃsabhakṣaṇam iṣyate | prokṣaṇadevābhyarcanarahitasya[91] tu prakṛtatvād asty anujñānam | vyādheś ca na kevalam utpannasya nivṛttyarthaṃ yāvat kṛśakṣayyāturadurbālādīnāṃ sarvakālaṃ māṃsāśanaṃ niyamata iṣyate |
strīmadyanityāḥ kṣayiṇaḥ śramavyādhyā ca karśitāḥ |
nityamāṃsarasāhārā āturāś cāpi durbalāḥ ||
aprokṣitasyāpi chāgamāṃsasya devatādyarcanaṃ tu tair avaśyaṃ kartavyam | asaṃbhave tu kasmiṃścid ahani na doṣaḥ || 5.27 ||
prāṇasyānnam idaṃ sarvaṃ prajāpatir akalpayat |
sthāvaraṃ jaṅgamaṃ caiva sarvaṃ prāṇasya bhojanam || 5.28 ||
prāṇaḥ kauṣṭhyo vāyuḥ jīvabījabhūtaḥ | pañcavṛttasyodānādikasya śarīrasthityartham idaṃ sarvaṃ jagat prajāpatir annatvenākalpayat[92] | idam iti sāmānyato nirdiśya viśeṣaṇaṃ nirdiśati sthāvaraṃ jaṅgamam iti | ato hetoḥ sarvaṃ prāṇasya bhojanam | tiryakprakṣimanuṣyasarīsṛpāvasthahetumadbhedanirdeśāt dvitīyaṃ sarvagrahaṇam apunaruktam | yataḥ prajāpatinā sarvam āpadi prāṇasya kalpitam | ataḥ sarvam etasya bhojanam | tathā ca prāṇasaṃvadopaniṣadi śrūyate "sa hovāca kiṃ me 'nnaṃ bhaviṣyatīti | yad idaṃ kiṃcit āśvabhya ā kīṭapataṅgabhyaḥ" (ChU 5.2.1) iti || 5.28 ||
carāṇām annam acarā daṃṣṭriṇām apy adaṃṣṭriṇaḥ |
ahastāś ca sahastānāṃ śūrāṇāṃ caiva bhīravaḥ || 5.29 ||
carāś caraṇpatanaraṇotsāhayoginaḥ śyenanakulādayaḥ | teṣām acarāḥ sarpakapotādayaḥ annam | evaṃ daṃṣṭriṇāṃ siṃhavyāghrādīnāṃ adaṃṣṭriṇaḥ rurupṛṣatādayo mṛgāḥ | ahastāḥ sarpamatsyādayaḥ sahastānāṃ nakulaniṣādādīnām | śūrāṇāṃ mahotsāhayuktānāṃ jīvitanirapekṣāṇāṃ bhīravaḥ priyajīvitāḥ | alpasattvā annatvena hanyante || 5.29 ||
nāttā duṣyaty adann ādyān prāṇino 'hany ahany api |
dhātraiva sṛṣṭā hy ādyāś ca prāṇino 'ttāra eva ca || 5.30 ||
attā bhakṣayitā | ādyān prāṇinaḥ attuṃ śakyān | pratidivasaṃ bhakṣayan na duṣyati | dhātraiva prajāpatinā attāra ādyā ubhaye 'pi sṛṣṭāḥ | tasmāt prāṇātyaye māṃsam avaśyaṃ bhakṣaṇīyam iti triślokī vidher asyārthavādaḥ || 5.30 ||
yajñāya jagdhir māṃsasyety eṣa daivo vidhiḥ smṛtaḥ |
ato 'nyathā pravṛttis tu rākṣaso vidhir ucyate || 5.31 ||
yajñārthaṃ māṃsasya piṇḍaprāśitrādijagdhir aśanam | eṣa daivo vidhiḥ, devair etad vihitam | anyathā tu māṃsāśinaḥ[93] sarīrapuṣṭyarthakamāṃsāśane pravṛttiḥ sa rākṣaso vidhiḥ | piśācānāṃ māṃsabhakṣaṇe sthitir iti nindā || 5.31 ||
krītvā svayaṃ vāpy utpādya paropakṛtam eva vā |
devān pitṝṃś cārcayitvā khādan māṃsaṃ na duṣyati || 5.32 ||
mṛgapakṣimāṃsaviṣayam idaṃ śāstram | rurupṛṣatādīnāṃ śaśakapiñjalādīnāṃ māṃsaṃ devānāṃ pitṝṇāṃ cārcanaṃ kṛtvā khādato na doṣaḥ | yathā gṛhe vaiśvadevādyarthe kṛte[94] saṃvidhānaṃ vināpi vaiśvadevenodanādibhojanam asti, na tathā māṃsasya | evamartham etat punarvacanaṃ devān pitṝṃś cārcayitveti | anyathā gṛhasthasya pūrvam eva bhojanam evaṃ rūpam | devebhya iti tena śabdenoddiśya śucau deśe māṃsasya prakṣepaḥ | yadi vā agnaye vāyave sūryāya jātavedasa iti devārcanaṃ kartavyam | agnau evaṃrūpā āhutayaḥ kṛtā[95] agnimato 'nyatra na bhavanti | na cāgau homena vinā baliharaṇaṃ[96] kartavyam, karmāntarasya prayogāntarasya ca pratipāditatvāt | āstāṃ tāvad etat |
anye tu śrāddhaṃ pitṝṇām arcanam āhuḥ | dṛṣṭaś ca śrāddhe 'rcanaprayogaḥ | pitṝṃś caiva devān[97] vadanti | tataś ca sarvasmṛtikāraiḥ śrāddham eva vihitam, na punar anyā kācid eva kriyā |
kathaṃ punar māṃsasya krayasaṃbhavaḥ, yāvatā āpaṇabhūmer māṃsaṃ krīyamāṇaṃ saunam āpadyate |[98] saunikair ahatasya svayaṃ mṛtasya paśor māmsam abhakṣyam anārogyakaratvāt |
ucyate | vyādhaśākunikādibhir āhṛtaṃ kreṣyate | na ca te saunikā iti prasiddhās taiś ca vikrayārthaṃ bhrāmyadbhir gṛha ānītaṃ bhavati | tadā saṃbhavati krayaḥ | na hi tat saunam ucyate |
svayaṃ vāpy utpādya | brāhmaṇo yācñayā, kṣatriyo mṛgayākarmaṇā || 5.32 ||
nādyād avidhinā māṃsaṃ vidhijño 'nāpadi dvijaḥ |
jagdhvā hy avidhinā māṃsaṃ pretas tair adyate 'vaśaḥ || 5.33 ||
pūrvoktād devādyarcanaśiṣṭāt brāhmaṇakāmanādinimittāt antaraṃ[99] yad bhakṣaṇaṃ so 'vidhis[100] tena nāśnīyāt māṃsam | uktānuvādo 'yam | āpadi prāṇātyaye devādyarcanam api nāpekṣyam |
nanu caitad api nimittatayoktam eva | tataś ca vidhir evāyaṃ nāvidhiḥ |
satyam | prokṣitasaṃbandhād go'vyajasyaiva tatra saṃnidhānāśaṅkāyāṃ[101] śaśādiviṣaye 'bhyanujñānārtham anāpadīty ucyate |
[102]vidhyarthānuṣṭhānaparo vidhijña ucyate | tathā laukikānuṣṭhāne 'pi jānātir upacārāt prayujyate | eṣa sa tajjānātīti anuṣṭhānapare prayuñjate |
atra phalakathāyām — jagdhvā aśāstrīyeṇa nimittena | preto mṛtas taiḥ prāṇibhir avaśo 'dyate | yena viṣayeṇa yo yeṣāṃ māṃsam aśnāti tasya vividhā pīḍā bhavati, etāvanmātraparam etat | anyathā prāyeṇa chāgādimāṃsam aśnāti lokāḥ, na ca chāgādayo māṃsāśinaḥ | atha vā tatkṣtena pāpena kravyādbhir apy adyamānas tair adyata ity ucyate || 5.33 ||
na tādṛśaṃ bhavaty eno mṛgahantur dhanārthinaḥ |
yādṛśaṃ bhavati pretya vṛthāmāṃsāni khādataḥ || 5.34 ||
prasiddhārthaḥ ślokaḥ || 5.34 ||
niyuktas tu yathānyāyaṃ yo māṃsaṃ nātti mānavaḥ |
sa pretya paśutāṃ yāti saṃbhavān ekaviṃśatim || 5.35 ||
saṃbhavān[103] janmāni | avaśyaṃ prāṇātyayasaṃbhave devārcanaṃ yo na karoti atha ca māṃsam aśnāti sa duṣyaty eva || 5.35 ||
asaṃskṛtān paśūn mantrair nādyād vipraḥ kadācana |
mantrais tu saṃskṛtān adyāc chāśvataṃ vidhim āsthitaḥ || 5.36 ||
prokṣaṇādayaḥ paśubandhe mantravantaḥ saṃskārā vihitās te yeṣāṃ kriyante paśūnāṃ vaidikayāgaśeṣāṇāṃ māṃsam adyāt | śāśvatam | śāśvato nityo vaidika ity arthaḥ | āśthita āśritaḥ || 5.36 ||
kuryād ghṛtapaśuṃ saṅge kuryāt piṣṭapaśuṃ tathā |
na tv eva tu vṛthā hantuṃ paśum icchet kadācana || 5.37 ||
yady eṣāṃ buddhiḥ syāt: "sītāyajñakhaṇḍiyajñacaṇḍikāyāgādiṣu[104] samācārapramāṇeṣu paśuvadhaḥ phalakāmasya nyāyyaḥ,[105] dṛṣṭā hi paśuvadhopayācitakenātiśayavatī sasyasaṃpattiḥ" iti, tanniṣedhārtham āha:[106] saṅge prastāvāt paśuvadhaprasaṅge ghṛtapaśuṃ kuryāt,[107] ghṛtapaśum eva kuryāt | paśunā yaṣṭavye tatsthāne ghṛtena yajeta devatāḥ | tad dhi sāmānyena yāgadravyam | atha vā piṣṭapaśuṃ piṣṭamayapaśupratikṛtiṃ kṛtvā devatābhya upaharet, piṣṭena vā puroḍāśādi kṛtvā |
katham ayaṃ vṛthā paśubandhaḥ |
ucyate | śiṣṭānāṃ[108] samācāraḥ pramāṇam, na tu[109] strīśūdrajanānām, avaidyatvāt | nātra vedamūlatā śakyā kalpayitum | devatārādhanārthaṃ tadā hy etad[110] ācaranti | na ca devatārādhanārthāni vaidikāni karmāṇi, guṇatvena devatāśruteḥ | anvayavyatirekamūlatāṃ cātrecchanti, "dṛśyate paśuvadhopayācitakena phalasaṃpatti" iti manyamānāḥ | ato na vedamūlatā | anvayavyatirekāv api bhrāntimātram, asakṛdvyabhicārāt |
ato 'yaṃ śloko nyāyaprāptārthānuvāda eva sauhārdād ācāryeṇa paṭhitaḥ || 5.37 ||
yāvanti paśuromāṇi tāvatkṛtvo ha māraṇam |
vṛthāpaśughnaḥ prāpnoti pretya janmani janmani || 5.38 ||
tāvatīr janmanām āvṛttīr māraṇaṃ prāpnoti | vṛthāpaśughnaḥ śrutismṛtyor acoditaṃ paśuvadhaṃ yaḥ karoti | tac ca prakaraṇān mahānavamyādiṣu laukikair yat kriyate | paśughna iti kapratyaye chāndasaṃ rūpam || 5.38 ||
yajñārthaṃ paśavaḥ sṛṣṭāḥ svayam eva svayaṃbhuvā |
yajño 'sya bhūtyai sarvasya tasmād yajñe vadho 'vadhaḥ || 5.39 ||
nāyam anantarokto doṣaḥ śrutismṛticodite vadhe | yo vadho yajñāṅgabhūtas[111] tannirvṛttyartham eva svayaṃbhuvā prajāpatinā paśavaḥ sṛṣṭāḥ utpāditāḥ | svayam evety arthavādaḥ | asya jagato viśvasya | yajñaḥ jyotiṣṭomādiḥ | bhūtyai, bhūtir vibhavaḥ puṣṭiḥ sphītiḥ | tasmāt tatra yo vadhaḥ so 'vadho vijñeyaḥ | hiṃsājanyasya pāpasya nivṛtter evam ucyate || 5.39 ||
oṣadhyaḥ paśavo vṛkṣās tiryañcaḥ pakṣiṇas tathā |
yajñārthaṃ nidhanaṃ prāptāḥ prāpnuvanty ucchritīḥ punaḥ || 5.40 ||
kathaṃ punar yajñe hiṃsādoṣo nāsti |
ucyate | hiṃsā hiṃsyamānasya mahān apakāraḥ, prāṇaviyogena putradāradhanavibhavādiviyogena sarvānarthotpatter duṣkṛtasya ca samanantaraṃ narakādiphalavipākasya pratyāsatteḥ | yajñe tu hatānām upakāraḥ, nāpakāraḥ, narakādiphalānutpatteḥ | yato yajñe nidhanaṃ vināśaṃ gatā ucchritīr utkarṣaṃ jātito devagandharvayonitvaṃ dvīpāntareṣūttarakuruprabhṛtiṣu varṣāntare vā janma prāpnuvanti |
arthavādaś cāyam | na hy atra vidhiḥ śrūyate, prāpnuvanti iti vartamānopadeśāt[112] | na cārthavādāt "pratitiṣṭhanti" itivad vidhipratipattir yuktā, vidhyantarasyābhāvād asaṃbhavāc ca |
sarvo 'yam avidhimāṃsabhakṣaṇapratiṣedhaśeṣaḥ | aihalokasaṃpādyatayāpy ayaṃ pratiṣedhaḥ: "na tv eva tu vṛthā hantuṃ paśum icchet" (MDh 5.37) iti | yac cābhyanujñānam "yajñārthaṃ pasavaḥ sṛṣṭāḥ" (MDh 5.39) iti, tat sarvaṃ bhaṣaṇapratiṣedhatayā pratīyate | tathā ca vakṣyati "nākṛtvā prāṇināṃ hiṃsām" (MDh 5.48) ityādi |
na cātra vidher asti saṃbhavaḥ | na tiraścām adhikāraḥ saṃbhavati, viśeṣavijñānābhāvāt | na cānadhikṛtasya kartṛtvam | nāpy akartṛtve śāstrīyāt karmaṇaḥ phalotpattiḥ | na hy atra dṛṣṭā vastusvābhāvyena[113] phalotpattiḥ | yathā viṣam aviduṣo 'pi pītavato janayaty eva svaphalam | naivaṃ vaidikārthāḥ |
acaitanyāc cauṣadhyādīnām[114] ṛtviṅnyāyo 'pi nāsti | dṛṣṭaṃ kila kutaścana karmaṇaḥ paraprayuktād apy ṛtvijāṃ phalam: "yaḥ kāmayeta[115] pāpīyān syāt" (cf. GoB 2.3.3) ityādi | tatra vidhyantaraśeṣatvābhāvāt spaṣṭatvāc[116] ca vidhipratipatter manuṣyādhikāratvāc ca śāstrasya yukto 'ṅgavyāpārasamāśrito[117] vācanikas tāvanmātro 'dhikāraḥ | yathā parakīyāśvamedhāvabhṛthe brāhmaṇasya prāyaścittam uktam | iha tv adhikāra eva nāstīty uktam |
oṣadhyo darbhādayaḥ | paśavaś chāgādayaḥ | vṛkṣāḥ pūjyāḥ | tiryañcaḥ apaśavo 'pi paśavo yeṣāṃ haviṣṭvena[118] codanā "kapiñjalān ālabhate" (VS 24.20) iti | bhārapravahaṇād[119] anaḍvāhas tiryañco vājapeyādau tiryañca iti vyapadiśyante | yady api teṣāṃ tatra nidhanaṃ nāsti tathāpi yāvatī ca pīḍā vidyata iti sā nidhanaśabdena lakṣyate | pakṣiṇaḥ kapiñjalādayaḥ | yady api te paśutvena cocyante,[120] aprasiddhataraprayogās tu "sapta grāmyāḥ paśavaḥ saptāraṇyāḥ" (ŚB 9.5.2.8) iti | gavādayo 'pakṣiṇaḥ | catuṣpājjātivacanaḥ paśuśabdaḥ | gobalīvardavad vā bhedo draṣṭavyaḥ || 5.40 ||
yāvatyaḥ kāścic chāstracoditahiṃsās tāḥ saṃkṣpya darśayati |
madhuparke ca yajñe ca pitṛdaivatakarmaṇi |
atraiva paśavo hiṃsyā nānyatrety abravīn manuḥ || 5.41 ||
eṣv artheṣu paśūn hiṃsan vedatattvārthavid dvijaḥ |
ātmānaṃ ca paśuṃ caiva gamayaty uttamāṃ gatim || 5.42 ||
madhuparko vyākhyātaḥ | tatra govadho vihitaḥ | yajñaḥ jyotiṣṭomādiḥ | tatra saṃsthaikādaśinyādipaśuvadho nirūḍhapaśuvadhādiḥ svatantra eva ca[121] | pitṛdaivataṃ pitaro devatā yasmin karmaṇy aṣṭakādau, na tu śrāddham | tad dhi siddhena māṃsena vihitam, na ca paśuvadhaś coditaḥ | na cedam eva vidhāyakaṃ yuktam, utpattau śrāddhasya hiṃsāyā acoditatvāt, asya ca vispaṣṭavidhānād aṣṭakāpaśuvadhenāpi netuṃ śakyatvāt, vidhitve cāsya mūlakalpanāprasaṅgāt, vidhyantaraśeṣatāyāś ca vakṣyamāṇatvāt | yeṣāṃ[122] tu mataṃ pitṝṇāṃ devatānāṃ ca karma mahāyañjādi | "brāhmaṇair vadhyāḥ . . . bhṛtyānāṃ caiva vṛttyartham"[123] (MDh 5.22) āpadi paśuhiṃsanam aprāptaṃ prāṇātyaye 'bhyanujñāyate || 5.41–42 ||
gṛhe gurāv araṇye vā nivasann ātmavān dvijaḥ |
nāvedavihitāṃ hiṃsām āpady api samācaret || 5.43 ||
avedavihitahiṃsāpratiṣedho 'yam | na ca vedavihitābhyanujñāyate | na ca gurau vasato brahmacāriṇo 'raṇye ca tapasyato 'nyā kācid dhiṃsāsti | avakīrṇino brahmacāriṇaḥ syād api | vānaprasthasya tu naivāsti | brahmacāriṇo 'py ātmopekṣaṇaṃ naiveṣyate | ato 'yaṃ vidhir eva śrāddhe | gṛha ity anuvāda eva |
yadi cāyaṃ vidhiḥ syād — "araṇye" "āpady api" iti kim ālambanam etat syāt | na ca vānaprasthasya sāgnikasyāpi paśuyāgo 'sti | "puroḍāśāś carūṃś caiva" (MDh 6.11) ity atra darśayiṣyāma iti kecit |
upādhyāyas tv āha | yuktaṃ brahmacāriṇaḥ | vānaprasthasya tu "aparājitāṃ vāsthāya" (MDh 6.31) ityādinātmatyāgāgo 'pi vihitas tasya nāsti jīvitārthā hiṃseti sphuṭataraṃ tatraiva nirūpayiṣyate |
nanu cāpady ayaṃ pratiṣedha ucyate | tat kutas[124] tatraivānujñānaṃ vyākhyāyate |
satyam | anyathā na kiṃcid anena kṛtaṃ syāt | arthavādārtham iti ced arthavādasyāpy ālambanam anveṣaṇīyam | ato nāpady ayaṃ pratiṣedho vidhiś cāpdy aviruddhaḥ | bahubhedād āpadām, alpīyasyām āpadi māsikam ardhamāsikaṃ vā bhojanaṃ bhaviṣyatīti buddhyā pravṛttir niṣidhyate | yadā tv eṣā buddhir adhunaivānaśnan na jīvāmi yadā vābhimukhāgata udyataśastra ātatāyī tadāpady anujñā | evaṃ "sarvata evātmānaṃ gopāyet" (GDh 9.34) iti śrutir anugṛhītā bhavati || 5.42–43 ||
yā vedavihitā hiṃsā niyatāsmiṃś carācare |
ahiṃsām eva tāṃ vidyād vedād dharmo hi nirbabhau || 5.44 ||
vedavihito yaḥ prāṇivadhaḥ so 'smiñ jagati carācare sthāvarajaṅgame nityo 'nādiḥ | yas tu tantrādiḥ so 'nvayavyatirekabhrāntyā idānīṃtanaḥ | ato vaidikīm hiṃsām[125] ahiṃsām eva vidyāt, amutra pratyavāyābhāvāt | ahiṃseti kāryata ucyate na svarūpataḥ |
nanu ca saiva hiṃsārūpā | abhedāt kathaṃ kāryo bhedaḥ |
ucyate | vedād dharmo hi nirbabhau | dharmasyādharmasya ca yat kathanaṃ[126] tad vedād eva, pauruṣeyāṇām aprāmāṇyāt | vedaś ca tasyā evābhyudayahetutvaṃ kvacit jñāpayati | svarūpābhedo 'pi nāsti, kratvarthapuruṣārthatvena bhedād āśayabedena pravṛtteḥ | laukikyāṃ māṃsīyato dviṣāṇasya vā pravṛttiḥ, vaidikyāṃ tu śāstreṇa coditam idaṃ kratuvartham iti |
nirbabhau niḥśeṣeṇa bhātaḥ, prakāśatāṃ gata iti yāvat || 5.44 ||
yo 'hiṃsakāni bhūtāni hinasty ātmasukhecchayā |
sa jīvaṃś ca mṛtaś caiva na kvacit sukham edhate || 5.45 ||
akāro 'tra pratiṣedhārthīyaḥ praśliṣṭo draṣṭavyaḥ | ahiṃsakānāṃ ca pratiṣedhāt sarpavyāghrādīnām apratiṣedhaḥ || 5.45 ||
yo bandhanavadhakleśān prāṇināṃ na cikīrṣati |
sa sarvasya hitaprepsuḥ sukham atyantam aśnute || 5.46 ||
bandhanavadhā eva kleśāḥ | atha vā viśasanādayaḥ[127] | tān yo na kartum icchati, viśasanam[128] eva yena na kṛtam, tadviṣayecchaiva yasya nivṛttā | na kevalaṃ pīḍāṃ na karoti, yāvad dhitaṃ prepsitum icchati sarvasya sa sukham atyantam aśnute || 5.46 ||
yad dhyāyati yat kurute ratiṃ badhnāti yatra ca |
tad avāpnoty ayatnena yo hinasti na kiṃcana || 5.47 ||
yac cintayati śulkam arhaṇādi | yatra ca ratim abhilāṣaṃ badhnāty abhipretya vastuni | tad ayatnena svalpenaiva kālenāvāpnoti | yat tu kurute karmaṇā tat karmaniṣpattisamantaram evāvighnena prāpnoti || 5.47 ||
nākṛtvā prāṇināṃ hiṃsāṃ māṃsam utpadyate kvacit |
na ca prāṇivadhaḥ svargyas tasmān māṃsaṃ vivarjayet || 5.48 ||
sarvasya hiṃsāpratiṣedhaślokasaṃghātasya māṃsabhakṣaṇaseṣatāṃ darśayati | yāvat prāṇino na hatās tāvan māṃsaṃ notpadyate | hiṃsā cātiśayena duḥkhāvahā | tasmān māṃsaṃ vivarjayet |
nanu ca svayaṃ mṛtānāṃ bhavaty eva māṃsam, kim idam ucyate "nākṛtvā" iti |
arthavādo 'yam | svayaṃ mṛtānāṃ ca māṃsaṃ rogahetutvād aprāptam eva | na hy adatvā māṃsaṃ bhakṣyate | na ca rogahetor dānam asti |
utpadyata iti māṃsasya hiṃsānimittatvāt kartṛvyapadeśe[129] samānakartṛkatvaṃ bhavaty evāviruddham | atha vā utpadyata iti na ca svargya iti | na svargānutpattihetumātram abhipretam api tu narakādiduḥkhahetutvam[130] || 5.48 ||
samutpattiṃ ca māṃsasya vadhabandhau ca dehinām |
prasamīkṣya nivarteta sarvamāṃsasya bhakṣaṇāt || 5.49 ||
aśucisthāne kukṣau garbhavṛddhiḥ, śukraśoṇitābhyāṃ vāśucibhyāṃ prabhāvaḥ | tathā vadhabandhau śarīravatāṃ tatkṛtau | etat sarvaṃ prasamīkṣya nipuṇabuddhyā tatvato nirūpya | nivarteta sarvamāṃsasya bhakṣaṇāt sarvasyāpratiṣiddhasyāpi, kiṃ punaḥ pratiṣiddhasya |
arthavādo 'yam | na punas tatvataḥ aśucy eva māṃsaṃ jñeyam | na hi tadaśucitvavidhiparaṃ vākyam || 5.49 ||
na bhakṣayati yo māṃsaṃ vidhiṃ hitvā piśācavat |
sa loke priyatāṃ yāti vyādhibhiś ca na pīḍyate || 5.50 ||
vidhir devārcanaṃ tad dhitvā yo na bhakṣayati, kiṃ tarhi vidhinā bhakṣayati | sa lokasya priyatāṃ prāpnoti | priyaḥ sarvasya bhavati | vyādhibhiś ca | kṛśadurbalāder māṃsam aśnato vyādhir upajāyate | tenāpi vidhinaivāśitavyam | tathā bhakṣayan vyādhibhiś ca na pīḍyate | anyathā aśnann api māṃsaṃ pīḍyata eva vyādhibhiḥ | piśācavad iti | piśācās tiryagjātiviśeṣās te vidhim anapekṣya māṃsam aśnanti | tato 'nyo 'pi tathā bhakṣayan piśācasadṛśo bhavatīti nindyate || 5.50 ||
anumantā viśasitā nihantā kravikrayī |
saṃskartā copahartā ca khādakaś ceti ghātakāḥ || 5.51 ||
anyena hanyamānaṃ svaprayojanato yady anyo 'numodate sādhv ayaṃ hantā karotīty anumantā | viśasitā hatasyāṅgavibhāgakāraḥ | upahartā pariveṣakaḥ | khādaka ity ete sarve ghātakāḥ |
aghātakeṣu khādanasaṃskāravikrayādikartṛṣu ghātakatve 'dhyāropite nindā, na punas tatvata ete ghātakā eva | laukikī hi vadhakriyā prāṇatyāgaphalā | tasya kartā ghātakaḥ smṛtito gamyate | svatantraḥ karteti viśeṣaśāstrādinā yaḥ prāṇaviyojanaṃ prāṇināṃ kroti sa hantocyate | krayavikrayādyāś ca kiryās tato 'nyā eva |
nanu ceyam api smṛtir eva, ete anumantṛprabhṛtayo ghātakā iti |
nedaṃ śabdārthasaṃbandhe pramāṇam, kiṃ tarhi dharmādharmayoḥ | abhiyuktataro hi tatra bhavān pāṇiniḥ | manvādayaś ca lokaprasiddhaiḥ padārthair vyavaharanti, na śabdārthasaṃbandhavidhiṃ smaranti | prayoktāro hy ete na smartāraḥ |
nanu ca "tam ācāryaṃ prakṣate" (MDh 2.140) ityādeḥ smaranty ete |
satyam | na tatra śāstrasmṛtivirodhaḥ | na ca teṣāṃ vākyānām anyat prayojanam asti | iha tu gauṇenāpi prayojanenārthavādatayāpy upapatter na ghātakatvaṃ śakyam avasātum |
ye 'py āhur "bhakṣakaś cen na vidyate vadhako 'pi na vidyata iti bhakṣaṇaprayukta eva vadhaḥ, prayojakaś ca kartā smaryate | tato mukhyam eva ghātakatvam | ato ghātakaprāyaścittam eva khādakasya yuktam" iti |
tad ayuktam iti[131] brūmaḥ | pṛthakprāyaścittaṃ hatānāṃ rasāsvādakasya "jagdhvā māṃsam abhakṣyaṃ ca" iti (MDh 11.151 ) |
yad api[132] prayojakatvena kartṛtvam uktaṃ tad api naivāsti | idaṃ hi tasya lakṣaṇam:
preṣaṇādhyeṣaṇābhyāṃ tu yaḥ svatantrasya codakaḥ |
sa kartā caiva[133] hetuś ca mukhyo nopacaran paraḥ || iti |
vadhako hi jīvanaprayuktyā pravartate māṃsavikrayeṇa jīviṣyāmīti, na tu khādakena viniyujyate |
atha tatsamarthācaraṇaṃ prayojakatvam | yo 'yaṃ kriyāṃ kartum adhyavasitas tatrānukūlyena yaḥ saṃvidhitsuḥ sa prayojaka iti | etad apy atra naivāsti | sādhanopanidhānaṃ trasataḥ paśor asvatantrīkaraṇaṃ[134] khaḍgopanayanam ity evaṃ saṃvidhānaśabdavācyaṃ yuktam | tena vinā kriyā na niṣpadyate |
atha yadarthaḥ kriyārambhaḥ sa prayojakaś ceti cet, māṇavakam adhyāpayatīty adhyāpanahetukartṛsaṃjñāpratilambhaḥ,[135] na hy adhyayanam adhyāpayatyarthaḥ[136] |
na cāsau kaṃcid[137] uddiśya hanane pravartate | yenāsya tadarthanirūpaṇāya bhakṣaṇe 'narthā pravṛttiḥ syāt | sarva ime svabhūtyai yatante | na kena kaśct paro 'nugrahītavya iti muhūrtam apy avatiṣṭhate ity api pūrṇakāmaḥ |
atha svārthaṃ pravṛttasya bhakṣayitāram antareṇa pravṛttir anarthikā | tasmiṃs tu sati phalavatī | phalaṃ ca prayojakam | tac ca khādakādhīnam iti pāraṃparyeṇa khādakaḥ prayojaka iti |
evaṃ tarhi yo dveṣād vadhyate sa hantuḥ prayojakaḥ syāt | tataś ca hanyamāna eva hantā saṃpadyate | na hi dveṣeṇa vinā hantṛtvopapattir iti | tathā brahmahatyāyām api sarvasvadānaṃ[138] pātakasaṃprayojakam | na hi pratigrāhayitāram antareṇa pratigrahopapattis tataś ca pratigrāhī na kevalaṃ pratyaveyād api tu dātāpi | rūpavatī ca strī smaraśaradahyamānahṛdayena rāgiṇā darśitaspṛhātiśayena śīlaṃ rakṣantī pratyaveyāt |
tasmān nedaṃ prayojakalakṣaṇam |
tau hi vadhakakhādakau svārthapravṛttau naṣṭāśvadagdharathavad itaretaropakāram anubhavantau, na punar anyataraprayojakau[139] | "śūdraviṭkṣatraviprāṇām" (MDh 8.104) ity atra śloke nipuṇam etan nirṇītam[140] || 5.51 ||
svamāṃsaṃ paramāṃsena yo vardhayitum icchati |
anabhyarcya pitṝn devāṃs tato 'nyo nāsty apuṇyakṛt || 5.52 ||
adhikapuṣṭyarthaṃ yo māṃsam aśnāti tasyeyaṃ nindā | na tu rogotpattibhayāśaṅkayā | yata āha | yo vardhayitum icchantīti | tasyāpy anabhyarcya pitṝn devān | na tu rogahetots tv arcanam akurvato 'pi kathaṃcid asaṃbhavān na doṣaḥ || 5.52 ||
varṣe varṣe 'śvamedhena yo yajeta śataṃ samāḥ |
māṃsāni ca na khāded yas tayoḥ puṇyaphalaṃ samam || 5.53 ||
devādyarcanaśiṣṭasya śaśādimāṃsasya bhakṣaṇam anujñātam | tato nivartamāno 'śvamedhaphalam aśnute | aśvamedhasya phalam "sarvān kāmān avaśyaṃ sarvāvijitīḥ" ityādi |
na cātra codanīyam: kathaṃ mahāprayāsena bahudhanavyayena ca tulyaphalatā māṃsanivṛtteḥ syāt | yata eṣo 'pi saṃyamo 'tiduṣkaraḥ | kiṃ ca lokavat parimāṇataḥ phalaviśeṣaḥ syād ity ayaṃ nyāyo jṛmbhata eva | ataḥ phalavidhau na doṣaḥ |
vayaṃ tu brūmaḥ | arthavāda evāyam | yato varṣe śataṃ samā iti cārthavādapakṣe[141] sughaṭam | na hi prativarṣam aśvamedhasya vidheyatvasaṃbhavaḥ | nāpi varṣe śatam, tāvataḥ kālasyādhikāriṇo jīvanādyasaṃbhavāt |
puṇyaṃ ca phalaṃ ca puṇyaphalam | samāhāradvandvaḥ | ṣaṣṭhīsamāse hy asāmarthyam || 5.53||
phalamūlāśanair medhyair munyannānāṃ ca bhojanaiḥ |
na tatphalam avāpnoti yan māṃsaparivarjanāt || 5.54 ||
medhyair devārhaiḥ | munyannāni nīvārādyannāny akṛṣṭapacyajanitāni | ayam arthavāda eva || 5.54 ||
māṃ sa bhakṣayitāmutra yasya māṃsam ihādmy aham |
etan māṃsasya māṃsatvaṃ pravadanti manīṣiṇaḥ || 5.55 ||
nāmadheyanirvacanam arthavādaḥ | māṃ sa bhakṣayitā | sa iti sarvanāma sāmānyāpekṣaṃ yogyenārthena nirākāṅkṣīkaroti[142] yasya māṃsam aśnāti || 5.55 ||
na māṃsabhakṣaṇe doṣo na madye na ca maithune |
pravṛttir eṣā bhūtānāṃ nivṛttis tu mahāphalā || 5.56 ||
"prāṇasyānnam" (MDh 5.28) ity ata ārabhya yāvad ayaṃ śloko 'rthavādasaṃghāta eva | dvitrāḥ ślokā vidheyārthāḥ[143] |
na māṃsabhakṣaṇe doṣo yathā "krītvā svayaṃ vāpy utpādya" (MDh 5.32) iti tathāyam api ślokaḥ | nivṛttis tu mahāphalety etad atra śrūyate | bahubhir nindārthākarair īdṛśaḥ saṃskāro jāto yan na kiṃcin māṃsam aśitavyam | bhūtānāṃ vṛttyartham āha: na māṃsabhakṣaṇe doṣa iti | devārcanaśiṣṭe brāhmaṇakāmyādiṣu nimitteṣu prāgukteṣu na doṣaḥ | kiṃ tu yady aśitum[144] icchanti | nivṛttir na bhakṣayāmīti saṃkapapūrvikā mahāphalā | phalaviśeṣāśruteḥ svargaḥ phalam iti mīmāṃsakāḥ |
evaṃ madye kṣatriyādīnām, maithune tu sarvavarṇānām, divodakyāparvakālād anyatra | alpasv alpā pravṛttir eṣā śāstrīyā | bhūtānāṃ śarīrasthitihetvarthā pravṛttiḥ | tathā cāyurvedakṛt |
āhāro brahmacaryaṃ ca nidrā ceti trayaṃ matam |
mādakaṃ ca striyaś caiva hy upastambhanam āyuṣaḥ || iti |
yas tu tena vināpi śaknoti jīvituṃ tasya nivṛttir mahāphalā | pradarśanārthaṃ caitat | aśiṣṭāpratiṣiddhaviṣayāṇām anyāsām api nivṛttīnām evam eva | yatra vidhānaṃ puruṣasya pravartamānasya prītyatiśayotpattiprayojanam anindyam, garheta vā yato nivṛttiḥ phalāya, yathā madhvaśanaṃ saṃpannabhojanaṃ rāṅkavaṃ paridhānam ity evamādi | tathā ca śiṣṭasamācāraḥ | vyāsaś ca bhagavān evam āha | ye tu saṃsaktito 'śiṣṭāpratiṣiddhā api yathā hasitakaṇḍūyanādayas tato nivṛttir dharmāya || 5.56 ||
pretaśuddhiṃ pravakṣyāmi dravyaśuddhiṃ tathaiva ca |
caturṇām api varṇānāṃ yathāvad anupūrvaśaḥ || 5.57 ||
caturṇām apītivacanaṃ sāmānyavihitā dharmāḥ śūdrasya nedṛśaṃ yatnam antareṇa bhavantīti jñāpanārtham | preteṣu jīvatāṃ śuddhiḥ | supsupeti samāsaḥ | prāpaṇaṃ cāpretavan nimittā śuddhir iyaṃ viśeṣasya | ataś ca yady api śuddhivacanaṃ pratijñāyate, tathāpy aśuddhisāpekṣatvāc chuddheḥ śāstrapratyayakārakatvād ubhayoḥ, apratijñātāpi prathamam aśuddhir ucyate || 5.57 ||
dantajāte 'nujāte ca kṛtacūḍe ca saṃsthite |
aśuddhā bāndhavāḥ sarve sūtake ca tathocyate || 5.58 ||
anujāto dantajātād bālatara iti smaranti | tathāvibhāgenoddeśamātram idaṃ yatas tadapekṣa āśaucakālabhedo bhaviṣyati | tad yathā smṛtyantare "ā dantajanmanaḥ",[145] tathā "bāle deśāntarasthe ca" (MDh 5.77) ityādinā sadyaḥśaucaṃ śrutam | bāla ajātadanto vijñeyaḥ | evaṃ ca "nṛṇām akṛtacūḍānām" (MDh 5.66) ity etad ekarātrikam āśaucaṃ dantajāte 'py avasthāpyate | evam ete smṛtī[146] viṣayavyavasthayā avirodhinyau bālaviṣaye bhavataḥ | naiśikī ca śuddhir ā cūḍākaraṇāt | yato nivṛttamuṇḍakānāṃ trirātraṃ vakṣyati | tac ca trirātraṃ prāg upanayanāt parataḥ "śuddhyed vipraḥ" (MDh 5.82) ityādi |
ye tu "daśāhaṃ śāvam āśaucam" (MDh 5.59) ity etān pakṣān vayovibhāgena varṇayanti, smṛtyantarāt samācārāc ca vyutkrameṇa saṃbandhayanti, daśāham upanītasya anupanītasya caturahaṃ kṛtamuṇḍasya tryahaṃ jātadantasyaikāham anujātasya sadyaḥśaucikādayas tu vikalpāḥ | evaṃ tryahacaturahayoḥ kṛtacūḍasya |
teṣāṃ mate smṛtyantaraprasiddho vṛttasvādhyāyāpekṣo na vikalpaḥ pratipāditaḥ syāt | taccottaratra darśayiṣyāmaḥ |
sarvavyāpāranivṛttyā mṛta ucyate, saṃpūrvasya tiṣṭhater vyāpāroparamadarśanāt | bāndhavāḥ sapiṇḍāḥ samānodakāś ca | sūtake ca putrajanmādau | tathocyate aśuddhā bāndhavāḥ sarva ity etenāsya saṃbandhaḥ |
kathaṃ punar atra vayobhedapratipattir yāvatā kṛtamuṇḍa iti saṃskārasaṃbandho gamyate | kṛtopanayane cety atra śrutam eva | ata eva kṛtacauḍaḥ kiyantaṃ kālam ucyata iti naiva śrūyate |
ucyate | dantajātānujātasāhacaryāt[147] kṛtamuṇḍaḥ kālalakṣaṇārtho vijñāyate | sa ca kālo 'tra prathamatṛtīyavarṣaḥ[148] |
yady api prathame varṣe vaikalpikaṃ muṇḍīkaraṇaṃ tasmint samāśrīyamāṇe "ā dantajanmanaḥ sadyaḥ"[149] ity etad bādhitaṃ bhavati |
tad apy ayuktam | kiyān avadhiḥ kṛtamuṇḍa iti | caśabdāt kṛtamuṇḍe ceti kṛtopanayane ceti labyate, saṃskārāntaraprāptau vyapadeśāntarapravṛtteḥ | evaṃ caitayā smṛtyā ekavākyatā bhaviṣyati "ā dantajanmanaḥ sadyaḥ"[150] ity atrāpi | "trirātram ā vratādeśāt"[151] iti vratādeśagrahaṇaṃ kālopalakṣaṇārtham eva | na ca brāhmaṇasyānityo 'ṣṭamavarṣe evaṃ kṣatriyavaiśyayor yaś ca kālaḥ, tadā śūdrasya na kaścit kāla uktaḥ syāt | tatrāpy atītaśaiśavasya "paripūrṇaṃ sarveṣām" itivacanāt | ataś ca ā aṣṭamād varṣād ūrdhvaṃ caturṇām api varṇānāṃ sarvāśaucam, śūdrasyāpi tasya kālasya sadbhāvāt | yasmiṃs tu pakṣe ekādaśe varṣe kṣatriyavaiśyayor upanayanaṃ lakṣyate tadā śūdrasya na kaścit kāla uktaḥ syāt | tatrāpy atītaśaiśavasya paripūrṇam, arvāk trirātram | śaiśavasya nivṛttiś ca smṛtyantare "prāg aṣṭamāc śiśuḥ proktaḥ", anyais tu " ā ṣōḍaśād bhaved bālaḥ" iti | ye 'pi ṣoḍaśād bālyanivṛttim āhus teṣām apy aṣṭamād ūrdhvaṃ māsiky eva śuddhiḥ | evaṃ paṭhyate "ūrdhvaṃ tu ṣaḍbhyo varṣebhyaḥ śuddhiḥ śūdrasya māsikī" | anyatra paṭhitam aṣṭavarṣasya māsa iti |
nanu vakṣyamāṇebhya eva vākyebhya eṣā vayobhedavyavasthā labhyate | kim anena dantajāta ity uddeśena |
satyam | sukhāvabodhārtham || 5.58 ||
daśāhaṃ śāvam āśaucaṃ sapiṇḍeṣu vidhīyate |
arvāk saṃcayanād asthnāṃ tryaham ekāham eva vā || 5.59 ||
sāpiṇḍyalakṣaṇaṃ vakṣyate | arvāk saṃcayanād iti caturahopalakṣaṇaṃ vakṣyati | "āhitāgneḥ saṃcayanaṃ caturthyām" iti vacanam asti | ayaṃ ca vikalpo vṛttasvādhyāyāpekṣo vṛttāpekṣo vā | tathā ca smṛtyantaram |
ekāhād brāhmaṇaḥ śuddho yas tu brahmāgnisaṃyutaḥ |
tryahāt kevalavedas tu nirguṇo daśabhir dinaiḥ ||
tatra trivedasyāgnimata ekāhaḥ | dvivedasya tu tryaham | nirguṇasya daśāham | gautamena (GDh 14.44) paṭhitaṃ sadyaḥ śaucam | tac ca viśeṣa eva brāhmaṇasya svādhyāyānivṛttyartham | tatra kriyāntarāṇi:
ubhayatra daśāhāni kulasyānnaṃ na bhujyate |
dānaṃ pratigraho homaḥ svādhyāyaś ca nivartate ||
ityādyāḥ kriyā nivartante | kevalaṃ bahuvedasyāguṇyamānaṃ praṇaśyatīti svādhyāyo na nivartate |
tathā vṛttyapekṣo yukto vikalpaḥ | ṣaṭkarmajīvino daśāhaḥ, tribir anya ity asya caturahaḥ, dvābhyām eka ity asya tryahaḥ | dāśāhika āśauce pratigrahādāv anadhikārāt prāṇayātraiva durlabhā |
ye tu "vayāṃsi catvāri, catvāraś cāśaucakālāḥ, ato yathāvayo yathāsaṃkhyena saṃbandhaḥ," teṣāṃ dantajāte daśāhaḥ prāpnoti, upanīte tu mṛte ekāha eva |
tatra smṛtyantarasamācāravirodhaḥ |
atha virodhaparihārārthaṃ prātilomyena saṃbandhaḥ kriyate | "upanīte daśāhaḥ kṛtamuṇḍe caturahaḥ tryaho dantajāte ekāho 'nujāta" iti |
atrāpi "nivṛttacauḍakānāṃ trirātrāt" iti virodhena vikalpo yuktaḥ, svaśabdena trirātrasyānuvidhānāt, caturahasya vṛttibhedena saṃcayabhedena viṣayatvasiddheḥ | smṛtyantreṇaivam ekavākyatā bhavati ekāhād ityanena | anyathā vayobhedena vikalpe vyākhyāyamāne vṛttasvādhyāyāpekṣo mānave śāstre kena vikalpo labhyate |
ato gautamavacanād yasya prātyahikena pratigraheṇa vināpi vṛttir asti kusūladhānyādes tasya bahusvādhyāyasya svādhyāyādhyayanamātre sadyaḥśuddhiḥ | ye 'pi tryahadayaḥ kalpās tatrāpi tryahaihikādīnāṃ tāvanmātra eva viśuddhir vṛttyarthe pratigrahe 'nenaiva gautamadarśanena | anyathā brāhmaṇasya svādhyāyina ity evāvakṣyat na svādhyāyānivṛttyartham iti |
ato yady apy aviśeṣeṇaikāhāc chuddhir ityādi śrutam, tathāpi niyatakriyāviṣayaṃ vijñēyam | yena nityavad brāhmaṇasya daśāham āha "śuddhyed vipro daśāhena" iti (MDh 5.82) | na hy anyat punarvacane prayojanam asti | tasmād vikalpo 'yaṃ yuktena mārgeṇa vyākhyeyaḥ | yatra punar bālādau sadyaḥśaucam, nivṛttamuṇḍakādau trirātram, tatra vikalpābhāvāt sarvakriyāsu śucitvam || 5.59 ||
sapiṇḍatā tu puruṣe saptame vinivartate |
samānodakabhāvas tu janmanāmnor avedane || 5.60 ||
anvayasaṃjñāvijñānād bāndhavagrahaṇānuvṛtteś cānvayajāḥ saptamapuruṣāvadhayaḥ sapiṇḍā ucyante | "yebhyaḥ svasya[152] pitā dadyāt tebhyaḥ putraḥ" iti jīvatpūrvapitrāder vidhānāt ṣaṭ tāvad yogyatayā sapiṇḍā bhavanti | yady api pitṛbhyo dīyate ātmanā saptama ataḥ pitāmahaprapitāmahādyāḥ pūrvānvayajātās[153] te sapiṇḍā iti vyapadiśyante | pūrve ṣaṭ sapiṇḍāḥ | apare putrādayaḥ ṣaḍ eva | yata ekasyāḥ piṇḍadānakriyāyāḥ sahabhāvāt sapiṇḍādyupadeśo labhyate, putrāder api sahabhāvaḥ pautrādinā kriyamāṇo 'yam, tena yebhyo dīyate yaiś ca saha saṃpradānavān bhaviṣyati sarve te sapiṇḍā vyapadiśyante | yato na tatra piṇḍadānam avadhyupalakṣaṇatvāc[154] chaṅkha[155] iva śaṅkhavelāyām[156] āgantavyam iti | tena yāvad uktaṃ syāt "prapitāmahasya yaḥ prapitāmahas tadanvayajā ye yāvat saptamās te sapiṇḍā," evaṃ[157] svasaṃtatau pitrādisaṃtatau draṣṭavyam | yata eva bhedas tam upādāya gaṇanā kartavyā yāvat saptamāvadhi | yathā pitāmaho yeṣām ekas te tata ārabhya saptamāvadhayaḥ sapiṇḍā ity eva sarvatra |
tadanvayajatve copalakṣaṇe jāter anāśrayaṇād vijātīyā api kṣatriyādayo brāhmaṇādīnāṃ sapiṇḍā bhavanti | ata eva tajjananādyāśauce brāhmaṇasya daśāha eva, teṣāṃ tu svakāla eva dvādaśāhādiḥ | ataḥ sarvasya vijātīyanimitte vijātīyasapiṇḍanimitte vā janmādau svakāla eva śuddhiḥ |
kṣatriyādīnāṃ brāhmaṇāpekṣayā tripuruṣaṃ sāpiṇḍyam | tathā ca śaṅkhaḥ:
yady ekajātā bahavaḥ pṛthakkṣetrāḥ pṛthagjanāḥ |
ekapiṇḍāḥ pṛthakśaucāḥ piṇḍas tv āvartate triṣu ||
"pṛthakkṣetrāḥ" bhinnajātīyāsu strīṣv ity arthaḥ | "pṛthagjanāḥ" pṛthakkṣetrasamānajātīyā apy anekamātṛkā bhavanti, tadartham ubhayor upādānam | "ekapiṇḍāḥ" sapiṇḍā bhavanti | kiṃ tu "pṛthakśaucāḥ" svajātinimitta eva teṣāṃ śuddhikālaḥ | brāhmaṇasya kṣatriyādeḥ sūtakādau daśāhaḥ, brāhmaṇasya sūtake teṣāṃ dvādaśāhaś ca | tathā cānyo 'pi viśeṣaḥ: "piṇḍas triṣv āvartate" | triṣv eva bhavati puruṣeṣu |
samānajātīyāpekṣayā kṣatriyādīnāṃ brāhmaṇavat ṣaṭ puruṣasya sāpiṇḍyam "ekajātāḥ pṛthakkṣetrāḥ" ityādiviśeṣaṇopādānāt | asamānajātīyāpekṣaṃ tripuruṣatvam anena vākyena śakyate pratipādayitum | eṣa evārtho 'nayā smṛtyā spaṣṭīkriyate:
kṣatraviṭśūdradāyādā ye suyur viprasya bāṇdhavāḥ |
teṣām āśauce viprasya daśāhāc chuddhir iṣyate ||
"ṣaḍbhis tribhir athaikena" ityādi ca |
strīṇāṃ tu vijātīyānāṃ bhartṛkālena jīvati bhartari śuddhiḥ | āha ca:
sūtau mṛte tu dāsānāṃ[158] patnīnāṃ cānulomataḥ |
svāmitulyaṃ bhavec chaucaṃ mṛte svāmini paitrakam ||
anye paṭhanti "asavarṇāsutānām" iti prathamaṃ pādam | yady ayam asti pāṭhas tadā putrāṇām api śūdrāṇāṃ pitṛgṛhe vyavasthitānāṃ tatparatantrāṇāṃ pitṛjātyapekṣayā daśāhādir eva śuddhikālaḥ |
dāsāś cātra vaitanikā gṛhyante | ye tu garbhadāsās teṣāṃ vidhyantaraṃ śrūyate:
kāravaḥ śilpino vaidyā dāsīdāsaṃ tathaiva ca |
rājāno[159] rājabhṛtyāś ca sadyaḥśaucāḥ prakīrtitāḥ || iti |
sparśane caivam eteṣāṃ śucitvaṃ vijñeyam, na punar dānabhojanādikriyāsu | yataḥ karmanimittā ete śabdāḥ, ataḥ kiṃ viparyaye śuddhiḥ kiṃ sarvāḥ kriyāḥ pratiprasavā uta kāścid evābhyanujñāyante | yato "rājñaś ca kāryāvidhātārtham" ity ākāṅkṣāyāṃ yāny eva karmāṇi tāny eva hṛdayam āgacchanti | tathaiva ca samācāraḥ |
nanu ca nātra sparśapratiṣedhaḥ śrutaḥ |
yāvatā smṛtyantare paṭhyate:
asthisaṃcayanād ūrdhvam aṅgasparśo vidhīyate |
tathānyac ca:
tribhiś caturbhir vāhobhir brāhmaṇaḥ spṛśyatām iyāt |
ekādaśena śuddhiḥ syān mṛtake sūtake tathā ||
"rājñaḥ ṣaṣṭhe saptame vā sparśaḥ, dvādaśāhenānnaśūddhiḥ | vaiśyasya sparśanam aṣṭame navame vā, pakṣeṇānnaśuddhiḥ | śūdrasya sparśanam ekādaśe dvādaśe vā, māsenānnaśuddhiḥ " iti[160] hāritaḥ | tathā vākyantaram api:
sparśe krameṇa varṇānāṃ tricatuḥpañcaṣair dinaiḥ |
bhojyānno daśabhir vipraḥ śeṣā[161] dvitriṣaḍuttaraiḥ ||
ete ca vikalpāḥ prayojanāpekṣayā guṇavad aguṇāpekṣayā vyavasthāpanīyāḥ | sarveṣāṃ tāvad brāhmaṇasya bhaktadāsās tricaturair ahobhiḥ sparśanena dūṣayanti | garbhadāsās tu sadyaḥ | evam itareṣām api varṇānā |
yatredaṃ sadyaḥśaucaṃ tatra sarvatra snānaṃ vāsasā ca | dravyasya śuddhir yā yasya vihitā iti jñāpayiṣyate (MDh 5.109) |
kanyānām api tripauruṣeyi sapiṇḍatā | "saputrāṇāṃ tu strīṇāṃ tripuruṣaṃ vijñāyate" (VaDh 4.18) iti vasiṣṭhaḥ | āśauca evaitat | vivāhe tu vidhir darśitaḥ |
sthitam etat: saptamapuruṣo maryādā, ṣaṭpuruṣāḥ sapiṇḍā iti | saptame prāpte vinivartate | samānodakabhāvaḥ samānodakavyapadeśaḥ | janmanāmnor avedane | janma ca "ayam asmatkule jātaḥ", nāma amuṣmād idaṃ nāmakāt pitṛpitāmahādeḥ | ubhayor avedane nivṛttir | ataś cānyatare jñāte[162] 'py aniṣṭodakaṃ jñeyam | "avatīrya nadīm anyad vā jalāśayaṃ nābhidaghnabhugno[163] dakṣiṇābhimukhaḥ savyottarābhyāṃ pāṇibhyām udakaṃ kṛtvānavekṣamāṇāḥ pratyāvrajeyuḥ" iti || 5.60 ||
janane 'py evam eva syān mātāpitros tu sūtakam |
sūtakaṃ mātur eva syād upaspṛśya pitā śuciḥ || 5.61 ||
evam etat sapiṇḍānāṃ janane | yathaiva daśāhādayaḥ kalpāḥ ṣaṭkarmādivṛttyapekṣayā svādhyāyālpamahatvāpekṣayā ca vyavasthitā maraṇe, tathaiva janane 'py āśaucamātram atidiśyate kālānavacchinnam | sāmarthyāc cāgṛhyamāṇaviśeṣatayā tatsaṃbandhasakalalābhaḥ | kālāvacchinnātideśe tu ekenaiva mukhyatvād daśāhena saṃbandhaḥ svādhyāyādiṣv syāt | yadi vā pāṭhapratyāsattyā[164] daśāhādyapekṣayā ekāhena ekenaiva[165] ca nirākāṃkṣīkṛtatvād anyais tryahādibhir na saṃbandhaḥ syāt | tatreyaṃ smṛtir aviśeṣeṇa vṛttasvādhyāyāpekṣāyāṃ vyavasthāyāṃ mṛtasūtakayor vidadhatī, janane guṇādyanapekṣayā jātimātre sthāpyamānā, virudhyeta[166] | samācāraś ca bādhitaḥ syāt |
nanu evaṃ strīṇām api tryahaikāhādayaḥ kalpāḥ sūtikānāṃ prāpnuvanti samācāravirodhinaḥ |
atrocyate | yady ayaṃ vikalpaḥ syāt tad evam[167] | vyavasthita evāsīt kalpaḥ | tathā hi tuśabda upapannataro bhavati |
sūtakaśabdaś ca nāśauce vartate | lakṣaṇayā sūtakasaṃbandhy aśaucaṃ lakṣayet | lakṣaṇāyāḥ sāhacaryād aspṛśyataiva lakṣayituṃ yuktā | yadi ca sarvam āśaucam abhipretaṃ syād āśaucagrahaṇam evākariṣyat "aśaucaṃ mātur eva" iti | ataś ca smṛtyantare trirātram aspṛśyatoktyā iha tadabhāvas tayor vikalpaḥ sūtakaṃ mātur eva | mātāpitror mātur eveti pitur vikalpaḥ | upaspṛśya snātvā śucir bhavatīti | upakramamātram idaṃ vakṣyamāṇena ślokena pitur api tryaham eva || 5.61 ||
nirasya tu pumāñ chukram upaspṛśyaiva śudhyati |
baijikād abhisaṃbandhād anurundhyād aghaṃ tryaham || 5.62 ||
sahetukaṃ tryaham upadiśann apasparśanaśuddhiṃ pūrvoktām anumanyate | kim artham ucyata iti cet, sarūpavidhitayārthavādārtham, na vidheyatayā "jartilayavāgvā vā juhuyāt" (TS 5.4.3.2) itivat[168] |
nirasya tu śukraṃ maithunadharmeṇa saṃprayujya śukrotsargād anantaraṃ upaspṛśya snātvā śucir bhavati | ato baijikād abhisaṃbandhāt | bījanimitto baihikaḥ | abhisaṃbandhaḥ apatyotpattiḥ | atas tatra kathaṃ nānurundhyān nānuvarteta | agham āśaucaṃ tryaham | yādṛśaṃ ca śukranirasanena akṛtasnānasyāśucitvam, na tādṛśam eva prasave, api tu tryaham | pūrvaślokārdhatryahaśeṣatayānūdyate | ata evopaspṛśyeti snānam ucyate, "snānaṃ maithuninaḥ smṛtam" iti vacanān nācamanam |
putre tu jāte tadahaḥ spṛśyataiveti kecit | tathā ca śaṃkha āha: "kumāraprasave nāḍyām acchinnayāṃ guḍatilahiraṇyavastraprāvaraṇagodhānyapratigraheṣv adoṣas tadahar ity eke" |
tasmāt sa divasaḥ puṇyaḥ pitṝṇāṃ prītivardhanaḥ |
smaraṇāc caiva pūrveṣāṃ tadahar na praduṣyati || iti |
tathā śrāddham apy eke kurvantīti ca | anena pituḥ sarvathāśaucābhāva eva |
tatraite smṛtī pūrvavad vṛttisadasadbhāvāpekṣayā vikalpyete[169] || 5.62 ||
ahnā caikena rātryā ca trirātrair eva ca tribhiḥ |
śavaspṛśo viśudhyanti tryahād udakadāyinaḥ || 5.63 ||
trayas trirātrā navāhāni | ekena ca ahnā ekayā ca rātryā ahorātraḥ | evaṃ daśāho vṛttānurodhād evam upadiṣṭaḥ | śavaspṛśaḥ śavasya snānālaṃkārādikāriṇaḥ | anyeṣāṃ snānamātraṃ vakṣyati tanniryāpakānāṃ ca | tathā ca prakaṭīkariṣyati "pretāhāraiḥ samam" (MDh 5.64) ity atra | etac ca samānodakānām, mūlyena vā nirharatām | anāthanirharaṇe tu smṛtyantare |
na teṣām aśubhaṃ kiṃcin nāśaucaṃ śubhakarmaṇām |
jalāvagāhanāt teṣāṃ sadyaḥ śaucaṃ vidhīyate ||
yat tu "asapiṇḍaṃ dvijam" (MDh 5.100) iti tatra vai vakṣyāmaḥ | udakadāyinaḥ samānodakāḥ | teṣāṃ ca "pṛthakpiṇḍe ca saṃsthite" (MDh 5.77) iti sadyaḥśaucam api vakṣyate | tatra vikalpaḥ | sapiṇḍeṣv etad asvādhyāyādyapekṣam || 5.63 ||
guroḥ pretasya śiṣyas tu pitṛmedhaṃ samācaran |
pretāhāraiḥ samaṃ tatra daśarātreṇa śudhyati || 5.64 ||
pitṛmedhaḥ carameṣṭiḥ | anye tu sarvaṃ karmaiva lakṣyata iti prāhuḥ | tat kurvan śiṣyo daśarātreṇa śudhyati | brahmacāriṇo 'py ayaṃ vidhir asty eva | pretāhāraiḥ samaḥ | pretaṃ haranti niryāpayanti tathā teṣāṃ daśāhaḥ | evaṃ śiṣyasyāpīty arthaḥ || 5.46 ||
rātribhir māsatulyābhir garbhasrāve viśudhyati |
rajasy uparate sādhvī snānena strī rajasvalā || 5.65 ||
garbhasrāve garbhamāsasamā rātrīḥ striyā eva śuddhir yuktā, iha vākye tasyāḥ śrutatvāt | sapiṇḍānāṃ tu smṛtyantarasamācārāv anveṣaṇīyau | vasiṣṭhena tu sapiṇḍānāṃ tryahaḥ samāmnātaḥ: "ūnadivarṣe prete garbhapatane sapiṇḍānāṃ trirātram aśaucam" (VaDh 4.34) | srāvas tu garbhasya māsatrayād ūrdhvaṃ prāg daśamān māsāt | kecit tu prāṅ navamād ity āhuḥ | aprāptakālasya pātaḥ srāva ucyate | na punar dravarūpasyaiva | tathā gautamena garbhasraṃsane "garbhamāsasamā rātrīḥ" iti paṭhitam (GDh 14.17) | saptamāsyāś ca jīvanti | ataḥ saptame māse pūrṇam āśaucam | etat tu jīvato jātasya yuktam anyathā tu garbhamāsasamā ity eva |
iha rajasvalāyā rajasy uparate snānena śuddhir āmnātā | smṛtyantare tryahād ūrdhvam | tatraivaṃ vyavasthā | prāk tryahād rajonivṛttāv api nāsti śuddhir ūrdhvam anuparate 'pi bhavati | kiṃ tu viśuddhyatīti | prakṛte punaḥ sādhvīti vacanād anivṛtte rajasi vaidikakarmādhikārānupraveśo nāsti, na punaḥ sparśādiniṣedhaḥ | utktam "ādyāś catasro ninditāḥ" (MDh 3.47) iti | rajasvalā strī rajasy uparate snānena sādhvī bhavati śuddhā karmayogyety evaṃ padayojanā | strīgrahaṇaṃ varṇamātrastryartham | pūrve tu ślokā brāhmaṇaviṣayā vyākhyātās tadāśaṅkānivṛttyarthaṃ strīgrahaṇam | uttaratrāpi yatra viśeṣapramāṇaṃ nāsti tatrāpi varṇamātraviṣayatayaiva, yathā "nṛṇām akṛtamuṇḍānām" (MDh 5.66) iti || 5.65 ||
nṛṇām akṛtamuṇḍānāṃ viśuddhir naiśikī smṛtā |
nirvṛttamuṇḍakānāṃ tu trirātrāc chuddhir iṣyate || 5.66 ||
imāḥ ṣaṣṭhīḥ "kartṛkarmaṇoḥ kṛti" (Pāṇ 2.3.65) iti kartṛlakṣaṇāḥ kecid vyācakṣate | akṛtacūḍa ekāhena śuddhyati | tathā vayo'vasthāpekṣo 'pi vikalpa ity ekīyamatam uktam | tasyaiva ślokasya vyavasthāvākye ime |
anye tv adhyāhāreṇa saṃbandhalakṣaṇā āhuḥ: akṛtamuṇḍānāṃ mṛtānāṃ ye sapiṇḍāḥ |
tatrottarapakṣaḥ samācārābhipretaḥ |
smṛtyantare sadyaḥśaucam apy āmnātam | viṣayas tatraiva darśitaḥ: "ā dantajanmanaḥ sadyaḥ ā cūḍān naiśikī nirvṛttacūḍakānāṃ trirātram" iti || 5.66 ||
ūnadvivārṣikaṃ pretaṃ nidadhyur bāndhavā bahiḥ |
alaṃkṛtya śucau bhūmāv asthisaṃcayanād ṛte || 5.67 ||
ūne asaṃskṛtasya dve varṣe yasya jātasya gate, sa ucyate ūnadvivārṣikaḥ | taṃ pretaṃ bāndhavā bahir grāmaṃ nidadhyur bhūmau nikhātāyāṃ sthāpayeyuḥ | smṛtyantare "nikhanet" (YDh 3.1) iti paṭhyate | alaṃkṛtya pretālaṃkāraiḥ | ūnadvivarṣe 'pi śrūyamāṇo 'laṃkāraḥ samācārāt kṛtopanayanādāv api vijñeyaḥ | śucau yatrāsthīni bhūpradeśe na santi | asthisaṃcayarahitatvena yā śuddhā tatra nikhāya sthāpyaḥ | smaśāne kilāsthīni saṃcitāni bhavanti | ata etena[170] vacanena tato 'nyatra nidhānam ucyate | na punas tādṛśasyāsthisaṃcayo na kartavya ity eva vākyārthaḥ | agnisaṃskārābhāvād eva tadaprāpteḥ || 5.67||
nāsya kāryo 'gnisaṃskāro na ca kāryodakakriyā |
araṇya kāṣṭhavat tyaktvā kṣapeta tryaham eva tu || 5.68 ||
kāṣṭhavad iti nirapekṣatām āha | śrāddham api na kartavyaṃ na codakam | udakakriyāniṣedhena śrāddhaniṣedhaḥ siddhaḥ aṅgāṅgibhāvāt | ataḥ samācāraprasiddhaḥ śrāddhaniṣedho liṅgena sādhayitavyaḥ |
anye tu smṛtyantaradṛṣṭanikhananapratiṣedhārthaṃ varṇayanti | tataś ca vikalpaḥ | kṣapeta udāsyeta | śāstracoditaṃ vyāpāraṃ na kuryāt || 5.68 ||
nātrivarṣasya kartavyā bāndhavair udakakriyā |
jātadantasya vā kuryur nāmni vāpi kṛte sati || 5.69 ||
ā trivarṣasyeti ā tṛtīyād varṣāt pratiṣedhaḥ | na punaś caturvarṣādau | evamartham evādiśabdaṃ kecit paṭhanti: nātrivarṣasya kartavyā trivarṣāder iti | samācāraś caivam eva | jātadantasya vā kuryuḥ | udakakriyāsāhacaryād agnisaṃskāro 'bhyanujñāyate |
nanu ca vikalpe kāmacāraḥ | tatra kaḥ prayāsasādhyaṃ vittakṣayakaram anuṣṭhānapakṣam āśrayeta | vyarthas taddupadeśaḥ |
ucyate | sarvavilakṣaṇo 'yaṃ pitror adhikāraḥ | pretopakārārtham etat kriyate | naimittikatvād avaśyakartavyam ity etat prāg evoktam | tatrāvaśyakartavyatāpratiṣedho 'stītīha niścīyate | pretopakārārthatvam astīty abhyanujñānena jñāpyate | tatrākaraṇe nāsti vidhyatikramaḥ | pretopakāras tv anuṣṭhānād bhavatīti vidhipratiṣedhayor nāsāmañjasyam || 5.69 ||
sabrahmacāriṇy ekāham atīte kṣapaṇaṃ smṛtam |
janmany ekodakānāṃ tu trirātrāc chuddhir iṣyate || 5.70 ||
sabrahmacārī samānacarṇo 'ta ekodakā rūḍhyā āsapiṇḍebhyaḥ[171] parigṛhyante | teṣām itaretaraṃ janmani sūtake trirātram | sadyaḥśaucam api smṛtyantarād udakadāyināṃ vikalpitaṃ draṣṭavyam || 5.70 ||
strīṇām asaṃskṛtānāṃ tu tryahāc chuddhyanti bāndhavāḥ |
yathoktenaiva kalpena śuddhyanti tu sanābhayaḥ || 5.71 ||
asaṃskṛtā yā vāṅmātreṇa pratigṛhītā na ca vivāhitās tāsāṃ maraṇe bāndhavāḥ patipakṣās trirātreṇa | sanābhayas tu sapiṇḍāḥ svapitṛpakṣā yathoktena kalpena "nirvṛttacauḍakānām"[172] (cf. MDh 5.66) iti jāter adhikārāt trirātreṇa |
anyais tūkam "sodaryā daśarātreṇa" iti | teṣāṃ cābhiprāyaḥ | aṣṭavarṣāyāḥ kanyāyā dānaṃ vihitam | adattāyāś ca nirvṛttacauḍakavyapadeśābhāvāt[173] puṃsa ivopanītasya, tadānīṃ kalpāntarasyānāmnānād daśāha eva yuktaḥ |
anyais tu paṭhitam "ahas tv adattakanyāsu bāleṣu ca viśodhanam" iti | tatra vyākhyātāraḥ pañcadaśābdadeśīyāpi yā hy adattā kanyā tiṣṭhet tadahar evāśaucam |[174] mukhyam āmnānam atikramya kālakṣapaṇe pramāṇābhāvāt |
tatrocyate | "bāleṣu ca" iti ko 'syārthaḥ | yāvatā uktam eva yogavibhāge "ā dantajanmanaḥ sadyaḥ" iti | na caitena tad bādhituṃ yuktam, sāmānyarūpatvād asya, tasya ca viśeṣavyavasthāpanarūpatvāt | ato 'yam ekāhaḥ pṛthag ukto 'pi ā cūḍād eva vyavatiṣṭhate, sāmānyasya viśeṣāpekṣatvāt | tasmād anārṣa evāyam ardhaślokaḥ pratipadyate: sparśaviṣayatayā neyaḥ | sparśapratiṣedho hi mṛtakasūtakayor bālasyāpi puṃvat prāptaḥ | tadartham etad uktaṃ syāt "ahas tv adattakanyāsu bāleṣu ca viśodhanam" iti | evaṃ ca viṣayasaptamyāśritā bhavati | sā ca yuktā kārakavibhaktitvāt | itarathā adhyāhṛtya bhāvalakṣaṇā saptamī vyākhyāyeta, "bāleṣu mṛteṣu jīvatāṃ śuddhiḥ" iti | na ca tadupasparśanād āśaucam etenaitat siddhyatīti | viṣayāntare tasya ca caritārthatvāt, bhūmau parivṛtatvāt, bhūmau parivṛtasya ca sparśanasaṃbhavāt |
aviśeṣoktau kuto viśeṣapratipattir iti cet |
tasyācamanakalpo vidyata ity etat saṃnidhau tādṛśasyaiva[175] sparśasya pratīyamānatvāt | tathā ca rajasvalāspṛṣṭino bālasya sparśanaṃ necchanti | athāsya viśeṣaṇaṃ syāt | tathā gautamena tad uktaṃ svasyāṃ smṛtau (cf. GDh 14.44) | yuktam evādhātum etasya | tasmād yuktaivādhānakālalakṣaṇā || 5.71 ||
akṣāralavaṇānnāḥ syur nimajjeyuś ca te tryaham |
māṃsāśanaṃ ca nāśnīyuḥ śayīraṃś ca pṛthak kṣitau || 5.72 ||
kṣāralavaṇam[176] | yavakṣārādi kṣāram | lavaṇaṃ saindhavādi | tan na bhuñjīran | lavanaviseṣaṇaṃ vā kṣāragrahaṇaṃ tena saindhavasya pratiṣedhaḥ | nimajjanaṃ ca nadītaḍāgādāv atīrthasnānam[177] aṅgaparigharṣaṇādivarjanam | māṃsāśanaṃ ca yāvad āśaucaṃ smṛtyantarāt pratiṣidhyate | evaṃ paṭhyate "na striyam upeyur na mārjayeyur na māṃsam aśnīyuḥ" | gṛhyakāras tu "tryaham anaśnanta āsīran krītotpannena vā varteran" (cf. ĀśG 4.4.15) ity āha | śayīraṃś ca sthaṇḍile parasaṅgavarjam | sūtake 'pi brahmacaryaṃ smṛtyantare pradarśitam || 5.72 ||
saṃnidhāv eṣa vai kalpaḥ śāvāśaucasya kīrtitaḥ |
asaṃnidhāv ayaṃ jñeyo vidhiḥ saṃbandhibāndhavaiḥ || 5.73 ||
saṃnidhau yatrāsau mṛtas tatra tat saṃnidhīyate | anye tu prayāṇakāle ye saṃnihitās teṣām evāyaṃ vidhir ity āhuḥ | saṃbandhinaḥ samānodakāḥ | bāndhavāḥ sapiṇḍāḥ |
anye tu grāmāntare nagarāntare 'vasthānam asaṃnidhānaṃ manyante, || 5.73 ||
teṣāṃ ca,
vigataṃ tu videśasthaṃ śṛṇuyād yo hy anirdaśam |
yac cheṣaṃ daśarātrasya tāvad evāśucir bhavet || 5.74 ||
videśo[178] grāmāntarādiḥ pūrvavat | vigataṃ mṛtam | anirdaśam | upalakṣaṇam etat | yasya ya āśaucakālas taccheṣaṃ tasyāśaucam | punar daśarātragrahaṇaṃ ślokapūraṇārtham | utpattyapekṣayā janmamaraṇayor āśaucakālavikalpenāvaśyam apekṣyam[179] | yadā sūtakādyutpannaṃ tadā prabhṛti daśāhādi kalpaḥ, na yadā[180] sapiṇḍair jñātam iti | ataś ca yadātithinā jñātaṃ sūtakādi na tu gṛhasthena tadāpy abhojyam annam | tathaivotpattinimittamātram idam ubhayatreti | daśāham āśaucināṃ tata ūrdhvam, trirātraikāhāśaucinā tu sacailasnānajā sadyaḥ śuciḥ || 5.74 ||
atikrānte daśāhe ca trirātram aśucir bhavet |
saṃvatsare vyatīte tu spṛṣṭvaivāpo viśuddhyati || 5.75 ||
yasya yaḥ kṛta āśaucakālo daśāhādis tasya tadūrdhvaṃ trirātram | yasya tu tryahaikāhādis tasya tata ūrdhvaṃ savāsasaḥ snānamātram eva | tathā cottaratra vakṣyati "savāsāḥ" (MDh 5.76) ityādi | saṃvatsare atīte atikrānte spṛṣṭvaivāpaḥ snātvā śudhyed ity arthaḥ | "hastena ca sapādena" ityādivacanāt, sarvāṅgasparśanaṃ pratīyate, tac ca snānam eva || 5.75 ||
nirdaśaṃ jñātimaraṇaṃ śrutvā putrasya janma ca |
savāsā jalam āplutya śuddho bhavati mānavaḥ || 5.76 ||
samānodakānām ayaṃ vidhiḥ | tryahaikāhapakṣe ca sapiṇḍānām api | savāsā vāsasā sahitaḥ | jalam āplutya snātvety arthaḥ || 5.76 ||
bāle deśāntarasthe ca pṛthakpiṇḍe ca saṃsthite |
savāsā jalam āplutya sadya eva viśudhyati || 5.77 ||
